528// Yaw spin envelope protection (faulted motors): blend the static fault command towards
529// spin_prot_max_cmd as |r| grows from spin_prot_start_rate to spin_prot_max_rate
530#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_RATE // Absolute max yaw rate, fully protected [rad/s]
531#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_RATE 34.0
532#endif
533#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_START_RATE // Yaw rate where protection starts to blend in [rad/s]
534#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_START_RATE 28.0
535#endif
536#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_CMD // Max command to the faulted motors, reached at max yaw rate [pprz]
537#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_CMD 4800.0
538#endif
539float spin_prot_max_rate = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_RATE;
540float spin_prot_start_rate = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_START_RATE;
541float spin_prot_max_cmd = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_CMD;
542float spin_prot_ratio = 0.0; // 0 = normal static command, 1 = fully protected
543// 0 ──── bleed ──── 24 ── hold ── 28 ── envelope + trim rising ── 34 ── fully protected ──▶
544// release start max
545// Spin trim: slow integrator that raises the static fault command while the envelope is active,
546// so that the equilibrium spin rate is pushed back below spin_prot_start_rate (e.g. battery drop)
547#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_ON // Enable the spin trim integrator
548#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_ON TRUE
549#endif
550#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RATE // Trim increase rate at spin_prot_ratio = 1 [pprz/s]
551#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RATE 1000.0
552#endif
553#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_BLEED_RATE // Trim decrease rate below release rate [pprz/s] (0 = only increase)
554#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_BLEED_RATE 1000.0
555#endif
556#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RELEASE_RATE // Yaw rate below which the trim bleeds off [rad/s]
557#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RELEASE_RATE 24.0
558#endif
559bool spin_trim_on = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_ON;
560float spin_trim_rate = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RATE;
561float spin_trim_bleed_rate = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_BLEED_RATE;
562float spin_trim_release_rate = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RELEASE_RATE;
563float spin_trim = 0.0; // Current trim [pprz]
564#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP // Min gap enforced between release < start < max rates [rad/s]
565#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP 1.0
566#endif
567float spin_prot_min_gap = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP;
568// Compile time checks of the airframe values (same limits are enforced at runtime, see spin_prot_bound_params)
569_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP >= 0.1 && ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP <= 10.0,
570 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP must be in [0.1, 10] rad/s");
571_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_RATE <= 60.0,
572 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_RATE must be <= 60 rad/s");
573_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_START_RATE <= ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_RATE - ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP,
574 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_START_RATE must be at least SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP below SPIN_PROT_MAX_RATE");
575_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RELEASE_RATE >= 0.0 &&
576 ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RELEASE_RATE <= ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_START_RATE - ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP,
577 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RELEASE_RATE must be >= 0 and at least SPIN_PROT_MIN_GAP below SPIN_PROT_START_RATE");
578_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_CMD >= 0.0 && ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_CMD <= MAX_PPRZ,
579 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_PROT_MAX_CMD must be in [0, MAX_PPRZ]");
580_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RATE >= 0.0 && ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RATE <= 1000.0,
581 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_RATE must be in [0, 1000] pprz/s");
582_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_BLEED_RATE >= 0.0 && ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_BLEED_RATE <= 1000.0,
583 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_TRIM_BLEED_RATE must be in [0, 1000] pprz/s");
584// Spin transition manoeuvre: nominal <-> pitch motors faulted, triggered from the GCS
585#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_RAMP_RATE // Yaw rate reference ramp [rad/s^2]
586#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_RAMP_RATE 2.0
587#endif
588#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_BLEND_TIME // Blend time of the pitch motors between allocator and static cmd [s]
589#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_BLEND_TIME 1.0
590#endif
591#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_TRIM_RATE // Open loop trim increase while slowing down [pprz/s]
592#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_TRIM_RATE 300.0
593#endif
594#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_DONE_RATE // |r| below which the spin is considered stopped [rad/s]
595#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_DONE_RATE 0.5
596#endif
597#define SPIN_MAN_PAIR_PITCH 0
598#define SPIN_MAN_PAIR_ROLL 1
599#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PAIR // Pair faulted by the spin up: 0 = pitch (FRONT/BACK), 1 = roll (RIGHT/LEFT)
600#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PAIR SPIN_MAN_PAIR_PITCH
601#endif
602#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PITCH_DIR // Sign of r when the pitch motors are faulted (+1/-1), roll fault spins opposite
603#define ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PITCH_DIR 1.0
604#endif
605_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PAIR == SPIN_MAN_PAIR_PITCH || ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PAIR == SPIN_MAN_PAIR_ROLL,
606 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PAIR must be 0 (pitch) or 1 (roll)");
607_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PITCH_DIR == 1.0 || ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PITCH_DIR == -1.0,
608 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PITCH_DIR must be 1 or -1");
609_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_RAMP_RATE >= 0.1 && ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_RAMP_RATE <= 10.0,
610 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_RAMP_RATE must be in [0.1, 10] rad/s^2");
611_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_BLEND_TIME >= 0.1 && ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_BLEND_TIME <= 5.0,
612 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_BLEND_TIME must be in [0.1, 5] s");
613_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_TRIM_RATE >= 0.0 && ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_TRIM_RATE <= 1000.0,
614 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_TRIM_RATE must be in [0, 1000] pprz/s");
615_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_DONE_RATE >= 0.1 && ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_DONE_RATE <= 5.0,
616 "ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_DONE_RATE must be in [0.1, 5] rad/s");
617// Third gain of the ANDI error controller (roll/pitch and vertical), equal to the hover motors actuator dynamics
618#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_EC_K3 // [rad/s], 22 on the RW3C, 29 on the PlusQuad
619#define ONELOOP_NB_EC_K3 22.0
620#endif
621_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_EC_K3 >= 1.0 && ONELOOP_NB_EC_K3 <= 100.0, "ONELOOP_NB_EC_K3 must be in [1, 100] rad/s");
622float ec_k3 = ONELOOP_NB_EC_K3;
623// Velocity PID limits (manual and NAV): max acceleration setpoint (sets the max tilt of the thrust vector in nB modes,
624// max_phi/max_theta do not limit it there) and max velocity setpoint. RW3C: conservative, PlusQuad: relaxed.
625#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_PID_A_MAX // Max acceleration setpoint [g] (0.12 g ~ 7 deg tilt, 0.6 g ~ 31 deg tilt)
626#define ONELOOP_NB_PID_A_MAX 0.6
627#endif
628#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_MANUAL // Max velocity setpoint in manual, also the full stick velocity [m/s]
629#define ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_MANUAL 3.0
630#endif
631#ifndef ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_NAV // Max velocity setpoint in NAV [m/s]
632#define ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_NAV 3.0
633#endif
634_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_PID_A_MAX >= 0.05 && ONELOOP_NB_PID_A_MAX <= 1.0, "ONELOOP_NB_PID_A_MAX must be in [0.05, 1] g");
635_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_MANUAL >= 0.1 && ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_MANUAL <= 10.0,
636 "ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_MANUAL must be in [0.1, 10] m/s");
637_Static_assert(ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_NAV >= 0.1 && ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_NAV <= 10.0,
638 "ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_NAV must be in [0.1, 10] m/s");
639float pid_a_max = ONELOOP_NB_PID_A_MAX;
640float pid_v_max_manual = ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_MANUAL;
641float pid_v_max_nav = ONELOOP_NB_PID_V_MAX_NAV;
642enum spin_man_state_t
643{
644 SPIN_MAN_IDLE,
645 SPIN_MAN_UP_RAMP, // no fault, yaw rate ref ramps up until |r| >= release rate, then fault spin_man_pair
646 SPIN_MAN_UP_BLEND, // pair faulted, blend from allocator cmd to static cmd
647 SPIN_MAN_DOWN_SLOW, // single pair faulted, open loop trim increase until |r| < release - gap
648 SPIN_MAN_DOWN_BLEND, // no fault, blend from static cmd to allocator cmd, yaw rate ref ramps to 0
649 SPIN_MAN_DOWN_RAMP // no fault, yaw rate ref ramps to 0 until the spin is stopped
650};
651bool spin_man_up = false; // GCS trigger: spin up, then fault spin_man_pair (clears itself)
652bool spin_man_down = false; // GCS trigger: slow down, unfault the faulted pair, stop the spin (clears itself)
653uint8_t spin_man_pair = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PAIR;
654float spin_man_pitch_dir = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_PITCH_DIR;
655float spin_man_ramp_rate = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_RAMP_RATE;
656float spin_man_blend_time = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_BLEND_TIME;
657float spin_man_trim_rate = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_TRIM_RATE;
658float spin_man_done_rate = ONELOOP_NB_SPIN_MAN_DONE_RATE;
659uint8_t spin_man_state = SPIN_MAN_IDLE;
660float spin_man_r_ref = 0.0; // Yaw rate reference [rad/s]
661static float spin_man_dir = 1.0; // Spin direction (sign of r once the pair is faulted)
662static float spin_man_alpha = 1.0; // Blend factor: 0 = held cmd, 1 = new source
663static uint8_t spin_man_mot[2] = {COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT, COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK}; // Motors of the pair being blended
664static float spin_man_u_hold[2] = {0.0, 0.0}; // Cmd of spin_man_mot captured at the transition
665static float spin_man_u_last[ANDI_NUM_ACT] = {0.0}; // Cmd of all motors applied in the previous loop

951//====================================================================================================================================
952// Functions Definition Section
953//====================================================================================================================================
954// General Mathematical Functions
959static void spin_prot_bound_params(void)
960{
961 Bound(spin_prot_min_gap, 0.1, 10.0);
962 Bound(spin_prot_max_rate, 2.0 * spin_prot_min_gap, 60.0);
963 Bound(spin_prot_start_rate, spin_prot_min_gap, spin_prot_max_rate - spin_prot_min_gap);
964 Bound(spin_trim_release_rate, 0.0, spin_prot_start_rate - spin_prot_min_gap);
965 Bound(spin_prot_max_cmd, 0.0, MAX_PPRZ);
966 Bound(spin_trim_rate, 0.0, 1000.0);
967 Bound(spin_trim_bleed_rate, 0.0, 1000.0);
968 Bound(spin_man_ramp_rate, 0.1, 10.0);
969 Bound(spin_man_blend_time, 0.1, 5.0);
970 Bound(spin_man_trim_rate, 0.0, 1000.0);
971 Bound(spin_man_done_rate, 0.1, 5.0);
972 Bound(spin_man_pair, SPIN_MAN_PAIR_PITCH, SPIN_MAN_PAIR_ROLL);
973 spin_man_pitch_dir = (spin_man_pitch_dir >= 0.0) ? 1.0 : -1.0;
974}
976static void spin_man_reset(void)
977{
978 spin_man_state = SPIN_MAN_IDLE;
979 spin_man_up = false;
980 spin_man_down = false;
981 spin_man_alpha = 1.0;
982}
984static void spin_man_set_pair(uint8_t pair)
985{
986 spin_man_mot[0] = (pair == SPIN_MAN_PAIR_ROLL) ? COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT : COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT;
987 spin_man_mot[1] = (pair == SPIN_MAN_PAIR_ROLL) ? COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT : COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK;
988}
992static void spin_man_start_blend(void)
993{
994 float u_avg = 0.5 * (spin_man_u_last[spin_man_mot[0]] + spin_man_u_last[spin_man_mot[1]]);
995 spin_man_u_hold[0] = u_avg;
996 spin_man_u_hold[1] = u_avg;
997 spin_man_alpha = 0.0;
998}
1000static void spin_man_ramp_ref(float target)
1001{
1002 float step = target - spin_man_r_ref;
1003 BoundAbs(step, spin_man_ramp_rate * dt_1l);
1004 spin_man_r_ref += step;
1005}
1007static bool spin_man_rate_ctrl(void)
1008{
1009 return (spin_man_state == SPIN_MAN_UP_RAMP || spin_man_state == SPIN_MAN_DOWN_BLEND ||
1010 spin_man_state == SPIN_MAN_DOWN_RAMP);
1011}
1016static void spin_man_update(bool in_flight, bool nb_ctrl)
1017{
1018 if (!in_flight || !nb_ctrl)
1019 {
1020 spin_man_reset();
1021 return;
1022 }
1023 float r = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[2]; // filtered yaw rate, same as the spin protection
1024 float abs_r = fabsf(r);
1025 switch (spin_man_state)
1026 {
1027 case SPIN_MAN_IDLE:
1028 if (spin_man_up && !fault_pitch_motors && !fault_roll_motors)
1029 {
1030 // Spin in the direction the drone naturally spins once the pair is faulted (the pairs spin opposite)
1031 spin_man_set_pair(spin_man_pair);
1032 spin_man_dir = (spin_man_pair == SPIN_MAN_PAIR_ROLL) ? -spin_man_pitch_dir : spin_man_pitch_dir;
1033 spin_man_r_ref = r;
1034 spin_man_state = SPIN_MAN_UP_RAMP;
1035 }
1036 else if (spin_man_down && (fault_pitch_motors != fault_roll_motors))
1037 {
1038 spin_man_set_pair(fault_roll_motors ? SPIN_MAN_PAIR_ROLL : SPIN_MAN_PAIR_PITCH);
1039 spin_man_state = SPIN_MAN_DOWN_SLOW;
1040 }
1041 else
1042 {
1043 spin_man_up = false; // reject a trigger whose precondition is not met
1044 spin_man_down = false;
1045 }
1046 break;
1047 case SPIN_MAN_UP_RAMP:
1048 if (!spin_man_up)
1049 {
1050 spin_man_state = SPIN_MAN_DOWN_RAMP; // abort: bring the spin back to zero, no fault
1051 break;
1052 }
1053 spin_man_ramp_ref(spin_man_dir * 0.5 * (spin_trim_release_rate + spin_prot_start_rate));
1054 if (abs_r >= spin_trim_release_rate)
1055 {
1056 if (spin_man_pair == SPIN_MAN_PAIR_ROLL)
1057 {
1058 fault_roll_motors = true;
1059 }
1060 else
1061 {
1062 fault_pitch_motors = true;
1063 }
1064 spin_man_start_blend();
1065 spin_man_state = SPIN_MAN_UP_BLEND;
1066 }
1067 break;
1068 case SPIN_MAN_UP_BLEND:
1069 if (spin_man_alpha >= 1.0)
1070 {
1071 spin_man_reset();
1072 }
1073 break;
1074 case SPIN_MAN_DOWN_SLOW:
1075 if (!spin_man_down || (fault_pitch_motors == fault_roll_motors))
1076 {
1077 spin_man_reset(); // abort (or fault flags changed by hand): stay as is, the normal trim logic takes over
1078 break;
1079 }
1080 if (abs_r < spin_trim_release_rate - spin_prot_min_gap)
1081 {
1082 fault_pitch_motors = false;
1083 fault_roll_motors = false;
1084 spin_man_r_ref = r; // yaw control resumes with zero rate error
1085 spin_man_start_blend();
1086 spin_man_state = SPIN_MAN_DOWN_BLEND;
1087 }
1088 break;
1089 case SPIN_MAN_DOWN_BLEND:
1090 case SPIN_MAN_DOWN_RAMP:
1091 spin_man_ramp_ref(0.0);
1092 if (spin_man_state == SPIN_MAN_DOWN_BLEND && spin_man_alpha >= 1.0)
1093 {
1094 spin_man_state = SPIN_MAN_DOWN_RAMP;
1095 }
1096 else if (spin_man_state == SPIN_MAN_DOWN_RAMP && spin_man_r_ref == 0.0 && abs_r < spin_man_done_rate)
1097 {
1098 spin_man_reset();
1099 }
1100 break;
1101 }
1102 if (spin_man_alpha < 1.0)
1103 {
1104 spin_man_alpha += dt_1l / spin_man_blend_time;
1105 Bound(spin_man_alpha, 0.0, 1.0);
1106 }
1107}
1109static float positive_non_zero(float input)
1110{
1111 if (input < FLT_EPSILON)
1112 {
1113 input = 0.00001;
1114 }
1115 return input;
1116}
1118void err_nd(float err[], float a[], float b[], float k[], int n)
1119{
1120 int8_t i;
1121 for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
1122 {
1123 err[i] = k[i] * (a[i] - b[i]);
1124 }
1125}
1127void err_sum_nd(float err[], float a[], float b[], float k[], float c[], int n)
1128{
1129 int8_t i;
1130 for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
1131 {
1132 err[i] = k[i] * (a[i] - b[i]);
1133 err[i] += c[i];
1134 }
1135}
1137void float_vect_diff_euler(float err[3], float a[3], float b[3])
1138{
1139 err[0] = (a[0] - b[0]);
1140 err[1] = (a[1] - b[1]);
1141 err[2] = (a[2] - b[2]);
1142 NormRadAngle(err[2]);
1143}
1145void integrate_nd(float dt, float a[], float a_dot[], int n)
1146{
1147 int8_t i;
1148 for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
1149 {
1150 a[i] = a[i] + dt * a_dot[i];
1151 }
1152}
1154void vect_bound_nd(float vect[], float bound, int n)
1155{
1156 float norm = float_vect_norm(vect, n);
1157 norm = positive_non_zero(norm);
1158 if ((norm - bound) > FLT_EPSILON)
1159 {
1160 float scale = bound / norm;
1161 int8_t i;
1162 for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
1163 {
1164 vect[i] *= scale;
1165 }
1166 }
1167}
1168//====================================================================================================================================
1169// Reference Model Gain Design Functions
1171static float k_rm_1_3_f(float omega_n, float zeta, float p1)
1172{
1173 omega_n = positive_non_zero(omega_n);
1174 zeta = positive_non_zero(zeta);
1175 p1 = positive_non_zero(p1);
1176 return (omega_n * omega_n * p1) / (omega_n * omega_n + omega_n * p1 * zeta * 2.0);
1177}
1178static float k_rm_2_3_f(float omega_n, float zeta, float p1)
1179{
1180 omega_n = positive_non_zero(omega_n);
1181 zeta = positive_non_zero(zeta);
1182 p1 = positive_non_zero(p1);
1183 return (omega_n * omega_n + omega_n * p1 * zeta * 2.0) / (p1 + omega_n * zeta * 2.0);
1184}
1185static float k_rm_3_3_f(float omega_n, float zeta, float p1)
1186{
1187 omega_n = positive_non_zero(omega_n);
1188 zeta = positive_non_zero(zeta);
1189 p1 = positive_non_zero(p1);
1190 return p1 + omega_n * zeta * 2.0;
1191}

1229static inline bool vec3_saturated(const float u_unsat[3], const float u_sat[3], float eps)
1230{
1231 return (fabsf(u_sat[0] - u_unsat[0]) > eps) ||
1232 (fabsf(u_sat[1] - u_unsat[1]) > eps) ||
1233 (fabsf(u_sat[2] - u_unsat[2]) > eps);
1234}
1235
1236// Standalone clamping / conditional-integration ARW for a 3D command with vector saturation. [web:32][web:33]
1237static void ARW_ClampVec3(const float err[3],
1238 const float u_unsat[3],
1239 const float u_sat[3],
1240 const float I_prev[3],
1241 const float I_cand[3],
1242 float I_next[3])
1243{
1244 const float eps = 1e-6f;
1245
1246 if (!vec3_saturated(u_unsat, u_sat, eps))
1247 {
1248 I_next[0] = I_cand[0];
1249 I_next[1] = I_cand[1];
1250 I_next[2] = I_cand[2];
1251 return;
1252 }
1253
1254 const float ds0 = u_unsat[0] - u_sat[0];
1255 const float ds1 = u_unsat[1] - u_sat[1];
1256 const float ds2 = u_unsat[2] - u_sat[2];
1257
1258 // If integrating would push further into saturation, clamp (freeze). [web:32]
1259 const float dot_err_ds = err[0] * ds0 + err[1] * ds1 + err[2] * ds2;
1260
1261 if (dot_err_ds < 0.0f)
1262 {
1263 I_next[0] = I_cand[0];
1264 I_next[1] = I_cand[1];
1265 I_next[2] = I_cand[2];
1266 }
1267 else
1268 {
1269 I_next[0] = I_prev[0];
1270 I_next[1] = I_prev[1];
1271 I_next[2] = I_prev[2];
1272 }
1273}
1274
1275static void Vel_PID_ARW(float x_dot_des[3],
1276 const float x_dot[3],
1277 float k_P, float k_I, float k_D,
1278 float a_sp[3], float a_max, float v_max)
1279{
1280 static float prev_vel[3] = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
1281 static float integral[3] = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
1282
1283 // const float a_max = 0.12f * 9.81f;
1284 // const float v_max = 3.0f;//0.5f;
1285 const float I_MAX = 0.4f;
1286
1287 float err[3];
1288
1289 float I_cand[3];
1290 float I_next[3];
1291
1292 float a_unsat[3];
1293 float a_sat[3];
1294
1295 vect_bound_nd(x_dot_des, v_max, 3);
1296 // Build candidate integral and unsaturated acceleration command
1297 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
1298 {
1299 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&KPID_vel_filt[i], x_dot[i]);
1300 err[i] = x_dot_des[i] - KPID_vel_filt[i].o[0];
1301
1302 I_cand[i] = integral[i] + err[i] * dt_1l;
1303 BoundAbs(I_cand[i], I_MAX);
1304
1305 // derivative on measurement (measured acceleration ~= d/dt(x_dot))
1306 const float vel_dot_nd = (x_dot[i] - prev_vel[i]) / dt_1l;
1307 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&KPID_filt[i], vel_dot_nd);
1308 prev_vel[i] = x_dot[i];
1309
1310 const float vel_dot_filt = KPID_filt[i].o[0];
1311
1312 // PX4-like sign: ... - D * vel_dot
1313 a_unsat[i] = k_P * err[i] + k_I * I_cand[i] - k_D * vel_dot_filt;
1314 a_sat[i] = a_unsat[i];
1315 }
1316
1317 // Apply the real saturation (vector magnitude)
1318 vect_bound_nd(a_sat, a_max, 3);
1319
1320 // Apply ARW (decide whether to accept the integral update)
1321 ARW_ClampVec3(err, a_unsat, a_sat, integral, I_cand, I_next);
1322
1323 // Commit I state and output saturated acceleration setpoint
1324 integral[0] = I_next[0];
1325 integral[1] = I_next[1];
1326 integral[2] = I_next[2];
1327
1328 a_sp[0] = a_sat[0];
1329 a_sp[1] = a_sat[1];
1330 a_sp[2] = a_sat[2];
1331}
1332
1333static void Pos_KPID_ARW(const float x_des[3],
1334 const float x[3],
1335 const float x_dot[3],
1336 float k_K, float k_P, float k_I, float k_D,
1337 float a_sp[3], float a_max, float v_max)
1338{
1339 static float prev_vel[3] = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
1340 static float integral[3] = {0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
1341
1342 // const float a_max = 0.12f * 9.81f;//0.05f * 9.81f;//0.12f * 9.81f; //0.5f * 9.81f;
1343 // const float v_max = 0.5f;
1344 const float I_MAX = 0.4f;
1345
1346 float v_d[3];
1347 float err[3];
1348
1349 float I_cand[3];
1350 float I_next[3];
1351
1352 float a_unsat[3];
1353 float a_sat[3];
1354
1355 // Position P -> velocity setpoint
1356 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
1357 {
1358 v_d[i] = (x_des[i] - x[i]) * k_K;
1359 }
1360 vect_bound_nd(v_d, v_max, 3);
1361 // Build candidate integral and unsaturated acceleration command
1362 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
1363 {
1364 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&KPID_vel_filt[i], x_dot[i]);
1365 err[i] = v_d[i] - KPID_vel_filt[i].o[0];
1366
1367 I_cand[i] = integral[i] + err[i] * dt_1l;
1368 BoundAbs(I_cand[i], I_MAX);
1369
1370 // derivative on measurement (measured acceleration ~= d/dt(x_dot))
1371 const float vel_dot_nd = (x_dot[i] - prev_vel[i]) / dt_1l;
1372 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&KPID_filt[i], vel_dot_nd);
1373 prev_vel[i] = x_dot[i];
1374
1375 const float vel_dot_filt = KPID_filt[i].o[0];
1376
1377 // PX4-like sign: ... - D * vel_dot
1378 a_unsat[i] = k_P * err[i] + k_I * I_cand[i] - k_D * vel_dot_filt;
1379 a_sat[i] = a_unsat[i];
1380 }
1381
1382 // Apply the real saturation (vector magnitude)
1383 vect_bound_nd(a_sat, a_max, 3);
1384
1385 // Apply ARW (decide whether to accept the integral update)
1386 ARW_ClampVec3(err, a_unsat, a_sat, integral, I_cand, I_next);
1387
1388 // Commit I state and output saturated acceleration setpoint
1389 integral[0] = I_next[0];
1390 integral[1] = I_next[1];
1391 integral[2] = I_next[2];
1392
1393 a_sp[0] = a_sat[0];
1394 a_sp[1] = a_sat[1];
1395 a_sp[2] = a_sat[2];
1396}

1398static void shape_vector(float a[3])
1399{
1400 a[2] += -9.81;
1401 vect_bound_nd(a, 1.0, 3);
1402}
1403static void eul_of_acc(float a[3], float psi)
1404{
1405 float phi_des;
1406 float theta_des;
1407
1408 float spsi = sinf(psi);
1409 float cpsi = cosf(psi);
1410 float aX = cpsi * a[0] + spsi * a[1];
1411 float aY = -spsi * a[0] + cpsi * a[1];
1412 theta_des = asinf(-aX);
1413 float ctheta_des = cosf(theta_des);
1414 if (fabs(ctheta_des) < FLT_EPSILON)
1415 {
1416 ctheta_des = FLT_EPSILON;
1417 }
1418 phi_des = asinf(aY / ctheta_des);
1419 BoundAbs(phi_des, max_phi); // Limit to 30 deg
1420 BoundAbs(theta_des, max_theta); // Limit to 30 deg
1421 eulers_zxy_des.phi = phi_des;
1422 eulers_zxy_des.theta = theta_des;
1423}
1424//====================================================================================================================================
1425// Attitude Conversion Functions
1427// void float_rates_of_euler_dot_vec(float r[3], float e[3], float edot[3])
1428// {
1429// float sphi = sinf(e[0]);
1430// float cphi = cosf(e[0]);
1431// float stheta = sinf(e[1]);
1432// float ctheta = cosf(e[1]);
1433// r[0] = edot[0] - stheta * edot[2];
1434// r[1] = cphi * edot[1] + sphi * ctheta * edot[2];
1435// r[2] = -sphi * edot[1] + cphi * ctheta * edot[2];
1436// }
1437
1439void float_rates_of_euler_dot_vec(float r[3], float e[3], float edot[3])
1440{
1441 float sphi = sinf(e[0]);
1442 float cphi = cosf(e[0]);
1443 float stheta = sinf(e[1]);
1444 float ctheta = cosf(e[1]);
1445 r[0] = ctheta * edot[0] - stheta * cphi * edot[2];
1446 r[1] = edot[1] + sphi * edot[2];
1447 r[2] = stheta * edot[0] + ctheta * cphi * edot[2];
1448}
1449
1451// void float_euler_dot_of_rates_vec(float r[3], float e[3], float edot[3])
1452// {
1453// float sphi = sinf(e[0]);
1454// float cphi = cosf(e[0]);
1455// float stheta = sinf(e[1]);
1456// float ctheta = cosf(e[1]);
1457// if (fabs(ctheta) < FLT_EPSILON)
1458// {
1459// ctheta = FLT_EPSILON;
1460// }
1461// edot[0] = r[0] + sphi * stheta / ctheta * r[1] + cphi * stheta / ctheta * r[2];
1462// edot[1] = cphi * r[1] - sphi * r[2];
1463// edot[2] = sphi / ctheta * r[1] + cphi / ctheta * r[2];
1464// }
1465
1467void float_euler_dot_of_rates_vec(float r[3], float e[3], float edot[3])
1468{
1469 float sphi = sinf(e[0]);
1470 float cphi = cosf(e[0]);
1471 float stheta = sinf(e[1]);
1472 float ctheta = cosf(e[1]);
1473 float spsi = sinf(e[2]);
1474 float cpsi = cosf(e[2]);
1475
1476 if (fabs(ctheta) < FLT_EPSILON)
1477 {
1478 ctheta = FLT_EPSILON;
1479 }
1480 edot[0] = r[0] + spsi * stheta / ctheta * r[1] + cpsi * stheta / ctheta * r[2];
1481 edot[1] = cphi * r[1] - sphi * r[2];
1482 edot[2] = sphi * r[1] + cphi * r[2];
1483}
1484//====================================================================================================================================
1485// Bounding Functions
1487void acc_body_bound(struct FloatVect2 *vect, float bound)
1488{
1489 int n = 2;
1490 float v[2] = {vect->x, vect->y};
1491 float sign_v0 = (v[0] > 0.f) ? 1.f : (v[0] < 0.f) ? -1.f
1492 : 0.f;
1493 float sign_v1 = (v[1] > 0.f) ? 1.f : (v[1] < 0.f) ? -1.f
1494 : 0.f;
1495 float norm = float_vect_norm(v, n);
1496 v[0] = fabsf(v[0]);
1497 v[1] = fabsf(v[1]);
1498 norm = positive_non_zero(norm);
1499 if ((norm - bound) > FLT_EPSILON)
1500 {
1501 v[0] = Min(v[0], bound);
1502 float acc_b_y_2 = bound * bound - v[0] * v[0];
1503 acc_b_y_2 = positive_non_zero(acc_b_y_2);
1504 v[1] = sqrtf(acc_b_y_2);
1505 }
1506 vect->x = sign_v0 * v[0];
1507 vect->y = sign_v1 * v[1];
1508}
1518float bound_v_from_a_vect(float e_x[], float v_bound, float a_bound, int n)
1519{
1520 float norm = float_vect_norm(e_x, n);
1521 norm = fmaxf(norm, 1.0);
1522 float v_bound_a = sqrtf(fabs(2.0 * a_bound * norm * xdot_lim_sf));
1523 return fminf(v_bound, v_bound_a);
1524}
1534float bound_v_from_a(float e_x, float v_bound, float a_bound)
1535{
1536 float norm;
1537 norm = fabsf(e_x);
1538 // norm = fmaxf(norm, 1.0);
1539 float v_bound_a = sqrtf(fabs(2.0 * a_bound * norm * xdot_lim_sf));
1540 return fminf(v_bound, v_bound_a);
1541}
1542//====================================================================================================================================
1543// Reference Model Functions
1559void rm_3rd_attitude(float dt, float x_ref[3], float x_d_ref[3], float x_2d_ref[3], float x_3d_ref[3], float x_des[3], bool ow_psi, float psi_overwrite[4], float k1_rm[3], float k2_rm[3], float k3_rm[3], struct OneloopStabilizationRef bounds)
1560{
1561
1562 float e_x[3]; // Attitude Error
1563 float x_d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Euler Dot
1564 float x_d_fw_rates[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Rates
1565 float x_2d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Acceleration
1566 float x_3d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Jerk
1567 float bounds_att_d[3]; // Bounds on Angular Rate (SUVAT based)
1568 float x_d_eul_ref[3]; // Euler angle Reference
1569 // Attitude error --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1570 float_vect_diff_euler(e_x, x_des, x_ref); // Calculate Attitude Error
1571 x_d_fw[0] = e_x[0] * k1_rm[0]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1572 x_d_fw[1] = e_x[1] * k1_rm[1]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1573 x_d_fw[2] = e_x[2] * k1_rm[2]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1574 float_rates_of_euler_dot_vec(x_d_fw_rates, x_ref, x_d_fw); // Convert Euler Dot to Angular Rates
1575 bounds_att_d[0] = bound_v_from_a(e_x[0], bounds.att_d[0], bounds.att_2d[0]);
1576 bounds_att_d[1] = bound_v_from_a(e_x[1], bounds.att_d[1], bounds.att_2d[1]);
1577 bounds_att_d[2] = bound_v_from_a(e_x[2], bounds.att_d[2], bounds.att_2d[2]);
1578 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates[0], bounds_att_d[0]);
1579 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates[1], bounds_att_d[1]);
1580 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates[2], bounds_att_d[2]);
1581 // Angular Rate error ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1582 err_nd(x_2d_fw, x_d_fw_rates, x_d_ref, k2_rm, 3);
1583 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[0], bounds.att_2d[0]);
1584 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[1], bounds.att_2d[1]);
1585 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[2], bounds.att_2d[2]);
1586 // Angular Acceleration error -----------------------------------------
1587 err_nd(x_3d_fw, x_2d_fw, x_2d_ref, k3_rm, 3);
1588 BoundAbs(x_3d_fw[0], bounds.att_3d[0]);
1589 BoundAbs(x_3d_fw[1], bounds.att_3d[1]);
1590 BoundAbs(x_3d_fw[2], bounds.att_3d[2]);
1591 // Angular Jerk Reference ---------------------------------------------
1592 float_vect_copy(x_3d_ref, x_3d_fw, 3);
1593 if (ow_psi)
1594 {
1595 x_3d_ref[2] = psi_overwrite[3];
1596 }
1597 // Angular Acceleration Reference -------------------------------------
1598 integrate_nd(dt, x_2d_ref, x_3d_ref, 3);
1599 if (ow_psi)
1600 {
1601 x_2d_ref[2] = psi_overwrite[2];
1602 }
1603 // Angular Rate Reference ---------------------------------------------
1604 integrate_nd(dt, x_d_ref, x_2d_ref, 3);
1605 if (ow_psi)
1606 {
1607 x_d_ref[2] = psi_overwrite[1];
1608 }
1609 // Attitude Reference ------------------------------------------------
1610 float_euler_dot_of_rates_vec(x_d_ref, x_ref, x_d_eul_ref);
1611 integrate_nd(dt, x_ref, x_d_eul_ref, 3);
1612 if (ow_psi)
1613 {
1614 x_ref[2] = psi_overwrite[0];
1615 }
1616 NormRadAngle(x_ref[2]);
1617}
1618
1635void rm_3rd_pos(float dt, float x_ref[], float x_d_ref[], float x_2d_ref[], float x_3d_ref[], float x_des[], float k1_rm[], float k2_rm[], float k3_rm[], float x_d_bound, float x_2d_bound, float x_3d_bound, int n)
1636{
1637 float e_x[n];
1638 float e_x_d[n];
1639 float e_x_2d[n];
1640 err_nd(e_x, x_des, x_ref, k1_rm, n);
1641 float max_x_d = bound_v_from_a_vect(e_x, x_d_bound, x_2d_bound, n);
1642 vect_bound_nd(e_x, max_x_d, n);
1643 err_nd(e_x_d, e_x, x_d_ref, k2_rm, n);
1644 vect_bound_nd(e_x_d, x_2d_bound, n);
1645 err_nd(e_x_2d, e_x_d, x_2d_ref, k3_rm, n);
1646 float_vect_copy(x_3d_ref, e_x_2d, n);
1647 vect_bound_nd(x_3d_ref, x_3d_bound, n);
1648 integrate_nd(dt, x_2d_ref, x_3d_ref, n);
1649 integrate_nd(dt, x_d_ref, x_2d_ref, n);
1650 integrate_nd(dt, x_ref, x_d_ref, n);
1651}
1652
1666void rm_2nd_pos(float dt, float x_d_ref[], float x_2d_ref[], float x_3d_ref[], float x_d_des[], float k2_rm[], float k3_rm[], float x_2d_bound, float x_3d_bound, int n)
1667{
1668 float e_x_d[n];
1669 float e_x_2d[n];
1670 err_nd(e_x_d, x_d_des, x_d_ref, k2_rm, n);
1671 vect_bound_nd(e_x_d, x_2d_bound, n);
1672 err_nd(e_x_2d, e_x_d, x_2d_ref, k3_rm, n);
1673 float_vect_copy(x_3d_ref, e_x_2d, n);
1674 vect_bound_nd(x_3d_ref, x_3d_bound, n);
1675 integrate_nd(dt, x_2d_ref, x_3d_ref, n);
1676 integrate_nd(dt, x_d_ref, x_2d_ref, n);
1677}

1689void rm_1st_pos(float dt, float x_2d_ref[], float x_3d_ref[], float x_2d_des[], float k3_rm[], float x_3d_bound, int n)
1690{
1691 float e_x_2d[n];
1692 err_nd(e_x_2d, x_2d_des, x_2d_ref, k3_rm, n);

1694 vect_bound_nd(x_3d_ref, x_3d_bound, n);
1695 integrate_nd(dt, x_2d_ref, x_3d_ref, n);
1696}
1697//====================================================================================================================================
1698// Error Controller Functions
1714void ec_3rd_pos(float y_4d[], float x_des[], float x_ref[], float x_d_ref[], float x_2d_ref[], float x_3d_ref[], float x[], float x_d[], float x_2d[], float k1_e[], float k2_e[], float k3_e[], float x_d_bound, float x_2d_bound, float fb[], int n)
1715{
1716 float e_x_d[n];
1717 float e_x_2d[n];
1718 float e_x_des[n];
1719 float_vect_diff(e_x_des, x_des, x, n);
1720 float max_x_d = bound_v_from_a_vect(e_x_des, x_d_bound * ec_headroom, x_2d_bound * ec_headroom, n);
1721 err_sum_nd(e_x_d, x_ref, x, k1_e, x_d_ref, n);
1722 vect_bound_nd(e_x_d, max_x_d, n);
1723 err_sum_nd(e_x_2d, e_x_d, x_d, k2_e, x_2d_ref, n);
1724 vect_bound_nd(e_x_2d, x_2d_bound * ec_headroom, n);
1725 // Calculate and bound distrubance --------------------
1726 float dist[3];
1727 float_vect_diff(dist, x_2d, fb, 3);
1728 err_sum_nd(y_4d, e_x_2d, dist, k3_e, x_3d_ref, n);
1729}
1730
1746void ec_3rd_att(float y_4d[3], float x_des[3], float x_ref[3], float x_d_ref[3], float x_2d_ref[3], float x_3d_ref[3], float x[3], float x_d[3], float x_2d[3], float k1_e[3], float k2_e[3], float k3_e[3], struct OneloopStabilizationRef bounds, float fb[3])
1747{
1748 float e_x[3]; // Attitude Error on Reference
1749 float e_x_des[3]; // Attitude Error on Desired
1750 float x_d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Euler Dot
1751 float x_d_fw_rates[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Rates
1752 float x_d_fw_rates_rm[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Rates plus RM
1753 float x_2d_fw[3]; // Forward Signal Angular Acceleration
1754 float bounds_att_d[3];
1755 // Attitude Error and Heading conversion --------------------------------
1756 float_vect_diff_euler(e_x, x_ref, x); // Calculate the Attitude Error
1757 x_d_fw[0] = e_x[0] * k1_e[0]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1758 x_d_fw[1] = e_x[1] * k1_e[1]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1759 x_d_fw[2] = e_x[2] * k1_e[2]; // Calculate Forward Signal Euler Dot
1760 float_rates_of_euler_dot_vec(x_d_fw_rates, x, x_d_fw); // Euler dot to rates conversion
1761 float_vect_sum(x_d_fw_rates_rm, x_d_ref, x_d_fw_rates, 3); // Add body rates reference signal
1762 float_vect_diff_euler(e_x_des, x_des, x);
1763 bounds_att_d[0] = bound_v_from_a(e_x_des[0], bounds.att_d[0] * ec_headroom, bounds.att_2d[0] * ec_headroom);
1764 bounds_att_d[1] = bound_v_from_a(e_x_des[1], bounds.att_d[1] * ec_headroom, bounds.att_2d[1] * ec_headroom);
1765 bounds_att_d[2] = bound_v_from_a(e_x_des[2], bounds.att_d[2] * ec_headroom, bounds.att_2d[2] * ec_headroom);
1766 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates_rm[0], bounds_att_d[0]);
1767 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates_rm[1], bounds_att_d[1]);
1768 BoundAbs(x_d_fw_rates_rm[2], bounds_att_d[2]);
1769 // Angular Rate Error ---------------------------------------------------
1770 x_2d_fw[0] = (x_d_fw_rates_rm[0] - x_d[0]) * k2_e[0] + x_2d_ref[0];
1771 x_2d_fw[1] = (x_d_fw_rates_rm[1] - x_d[1]) * k2_e[1] + x_2d_ref[1];
1772 x_2d_fw[2] = (x_d_fw_rates_rm[2] - x_d[2]) * k2_e[2] + x_2d_ref[2];
1773 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[0], bounds.att_2d[0] * ec_headroom);
1774 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[1], bounds.att_2d[1] * ec_headroom);
1775 BoundAbs(x_2d_fw[2], bounds.att_2d[2] * ec_headroom);
1776 // Calculate and bound distrubance --------------------------------------
1777 float dist[3];
1778 float fb_k3[3]; // local copy: fb is an input and is reused by the caller (nB_EC), do not modify it
1779 fb_k3[0] = fb[0] / k3_e[0];
1780 fb_k3[1] = fb[1] / k3_e[1];
1781 fb_k3[2] = fb[2] / k3_e[2];
1782 float_vect_diff(dist, x_2d, fb_k3, 3); // The Disturbance is THe difference between the measurment and the Model
1783 // Here we can bound the disturbance to avoid too large control efforts
1784 // Example MAX YAW CONTROL EFFORT: BoundAbs(dist[2], oneloop_nB_yaw_dist_limit);
1785 // Angular Acceleration Error -------------------------------------------
1786 err_sum_nd(y_4d, x_2d_fw, dist, k3_e, x_3d_ref, 3);
1787}
1788
1796static float ec_poles(float p_rm, float slow_pole, float k)
1797{
1798 p_rm = positive_non_zero(p_rm);
1799 slow_pole = positive_non_zero(slow_pole);
1800 k = positive_non_zero(k);
1801 // float omega_n = (2*p_rm*slow_pole*k)/(3*slow_pole-p_rm);
1802 float omega_n = (2 * k * p_rm * slow_pole) / (3 * slow_pole - k * p_rm);
1803 return omega_n;
1804}

1818 p_alt_e.omega_n = ec_poles(p_alt_rm.omega_n, slow_pole / 3.0, 1.28); // k = 1.28; 1.0;// 3.0

1872void init_controller_gains(void)
1873{
1874 /*Register a variable from nav_hybrid. Should be improved when nav hybrid is final.*/
1875 float max_wind = 20.0;
1876 max_v_nav = nav_max_speed + max_wind;
1877 max_a_nav = nav_max_acceleration_sp;
1878 /*Some calculations in case new poles have been specified*/
1879 // init_poles_att();
1880 // init_poles_pos();
1881 p_att_rm.p3 = p_att_rm.omega_n * p_att_rm.zeta;
1882 p_pos_rm.p3 = p_pos_rm.omega_n * p_pos_rm.zeta;
1883 p_alt_rm.p3 = p_alt_rm.omega_n * p_alt_rm.zeta;
1884 p_head_rm.p3 = p_head_rm.omega_n * p_head_rm.zeta;
1885
1886 //--ANDI Controller gains --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1887 /*Attitude Loop*/
1888 k_att_e.k1[0] = k_rm_1_3_f(p_roll_e.omega_n, p_roll_e.zeta, p_roll_e.p3); // k_rm_1_3_f(p_att_e.omega_n, p_att_e.zeta, p_att_e.p3);
1889 k_att_e.k2[0] = k_rm_2_3_f(p_roll_e.omega_n, p_roll_e.zeta, p_roll_e.p3); // k_rm_2_3_f(p_att_e.omega_n, p_att_e.zeta, p_att_e.p3);
1890 k_att_e.k3[0] = k_rm_3_3_f(p_roll_e.omega_n, p_roll_e.zeta, p_roll_e.p3); // k_rm_3_3_f(p_att_e.omega_n, p_att_e.zeta, p_att_e.p3);
1891
1892 k_att_e.k1[1] = k_rm_1_3_f(p_att_e.omega_n, p_att_e.zeta, p_att_e.p3); // k_att_e.k1[0];
1893 k_att_e.k2[1] = k_rm_2_3_f(p_att_e.omega_n, p_att_e.zeta, p_att_e.p3); // k_att_e.k2[0];
1894 k_att_e.k3[1] = k_rm_3_3_f(p_att_e.omega_n, p_att_e.zeta, p_att_e.p3); // k_att_e.k3[0];
1895
1896 k_att_rm.k1[0] = k_rm_1_3_f(p_att_rm.omega_n, p_att_rm.zeta, p_att_rm.p3);
1897 k_att_rm.k2[0] = k_rm_2_3_f(p_att_rm.omega_n, p_att_rm.zeta, p_att_rm.p3);
1898 k_att_rm.k3[0] = k_rm_3_3_f(p_att_rm.omega_n, p_att_rm.zeta, p_att_rm.p3);
1899 k_att_rm.k1[1] = k_att_rm.k1[0];
1900 k_att_rm.k2[1] = k_att_rm.k2[0];
1901 k_att_rm.k3[1] = k_att_rm.k3[0];
1902
1903 /*Heading Loop NAV*/
1904 k_att_e.k1[2] = k_rm_1_3_f(p_head_e.omega_n, p_head_e.zeta, p_head_e.p3);
1905 k_att_e.k2[2] = k_rm_2_3_f(p_head_e.omega_n, p_head_e.zeta, p_head_e.p3);
1906 k_att_e.k3[2] = k_rm_3_3_f(p_head_e.omega_n, p_head_e.zeta, p_head_e.p3);

2017static inline void init_filter_on_type(struct LP_t *filter, float x0)
2018{
2019 switch (filter->filter_type)
2020 {
2021 case LOWPASS_1:
2022 init_first_order_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.lp1, filter->tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, x0);
2023 break;
2024 case BUTTERWORTH_2:
2025 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.bw2, filter->tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, x0);
2026 break;
2027 case BUTTERWORTH_4:
2028 init_butterworth_4_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.bw4, filter->tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, x0);
2029 break;
2030 case NOTCH:
2031 notch_filter_init(&filter->meas_filt.notch, filter->freq, filter->bandwidth, PERIODIC_FREQUENCY);
2032 break;
2033 default:
2034 // Handle unexpected filter type
2035 break;
2036 }
2037}
2039static inline void update_filter_on_type(struct LP_t *filter, float input)
2040{
2041 // filter->meas_prev = filter->meas;
2042 // filter->meas = input;
2043 switch (filter->filter_type)
2044 {
2045 case LOWPASS_1:
2046 update_first_order_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.lp1, input);
2047 filter->out = filter->meas_filt.lp1.last_out;
2048 break;
2049 case BUTTERWORTH_2:
2050 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.bw2, input);
2051 filter->out = filter->meas_filt.bw2.o[0];
2052 break;
2053 case BUTTERWORTH_4:
2054 update_butterworth_4_low_pass(&filter->meas_filt.bw4, input);
2055 filter->out = filter->meas_filt.bw4.lp2.o[0];
2056 break;
2057 case NOTCH:
2058 {
2059 notch_filter_update(&filter->meas_filt.notch, &input, &filter->out);
2060 break;
2061 }
2062 default:
2063 filter->out = 0.0;
2064 break;
2065 // Handle unexpected filter type
2066 }
2067}
2069static inline void init_LP(struct LP_t *LP, float fc)
2070{
2071 LP->freq = fc;
2072 LP->freq_set = fc;
2073 LP->tau = 1 / (2 * M_PI * LP->freq);
2074#ifdef USE_LP1
2075 LP->filter_type = LOWPASS_1;
2076#elif defined(USE_BW2)
2077 LP->filter_type = BUTTERWORTH_2;
2078#elif defined(USE_YAW_LP4)
2079 LP->filter_type = BUTTERWORTH_4;
2080#endif
2081 init_filter_on_type(LP, 0.0);
2082 // init_first_order_low_pass(&LP->meas_filt, LP->tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
2083 LP->meas = 0.0;
2084 LP->meas_prev = 0.0;
2085 LP->out = 0.0;
2086}
2088static inline void reinit_LP_synchronous(struct LP_t *LP, struct LP_t *f, bool reinit)
2089{
2090 if (LP->freq != LP->freq_set || reinit)
2091 {
2092 LP->freq = LP->freq_set;
2093 LP->tau = 1 / (2 * M_PI * LP->freq);
2094 init_filter_on_type(LP, LP->out);
2095 init_filter_on_type(f, f->out);
2096 }
2097}
2098static inline void reinit_LP(struct LP_t *LP, bool reinit)
2099{
2100 if (LP->freq != LP->freq_set || reinit)
2101 {
2102 LP->freq = LP->freq_set;
2103 LP->tau = 1 / (2 * M_PI * LP->freq);
2104 init_filter_on_type(LP, LP->out);
2105 }
2106}

2176void init_filter(void)
2177{
2178 // Filtering of the velocities
2179 float tau = 1.0 / (2.0 * M_PI * oneloop_nB_filt_cutoff);
2180 float tau_v = 1.0 / (2.0 * M_PI * oneloop_nB_filt_cutoff_v);
2181 // float tau_2 = 1.0 / (2.0 * M_PI * 2.0);
2182 float tau_r = 1.0 / (5.0);
2183 // printf("tau: %f tau_v: %f\n", tau, tau_v);
2184 // printf("initializing filters\n");
2185 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&accely_filt, tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, accely_filt.o[0]);
2186 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&airspeed_filt, tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, airspeed_filt.o[0]);
2187 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
2188 {
2189 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&KPID_vel_filt[i], tau_v, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, KPID_vel_filt[i].o[0]);
2190 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&KPID_filt[i], tau_v, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
2191 }
2192 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&push_PID_vel[0], tau_r, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, push_PID_vel[0].o[0]);
2193 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&push_PID_vel[1], tau_r, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, push_PID_vel[1].o[0]);
2194 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&push_PID_vel_d[0], tau_r, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, push_PID_vel_d[0].o[0]);
2195 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&push_PID_vel_d[1], tau_r, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, push_PID_vel_d[1].o[0]);
2196 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2197 {
2198 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&u_filt[i], tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
2199 }
2200 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
2201 {
2202 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_filt[i], tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
2203 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_2d_filt[i], tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
2204 }
2205 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_3d_state_filt[0], tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
2206 init_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_3d_state_filt[1], tau, 1.0 / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY, 0.0);
2207}

2210void oneloop_nB_propagate_filters(void)
2211{
2212 reinit_all_LP(false);
2213 struct NedCoor_f *veloc = stateGetSpeedNed_f();
2214 struct FloatRates *body_rates = stateGetBodyRates_f();
2215#ifdef USE_ND_VELOCITIES
2216 static bool vel_inited = false;
2217 static struct NedCoor_f veloc_prev;
2218 if (!vel_inited)
2219 {
2220 veloc_prev = *veloc;
2221 vel_inited = true;
2222 }
2223 LP.ax.meas = (veloc->x - veloc_prev.x) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2224 LP.ay.meas = (veloc->y - veloc_prev.y) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2225 LP.az.meas = (veloc->z - veloc_prev.z) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2226 veloc_prev = *veloc;
2227#else
2228 struct NedCoor_f *accel = stateGetAccelNed_f();
2229 LP.ax.meas = accel->x;
2230 LP.ay.meas = accel->y;
2231 LP.az.meas = accel->z;
2232#endif
2233 LP.p.meas_prev = LP.p.meas;
2234 LP.q.meas_prev = LP.q.meas;
2235 LP.r.meas_prev = LP.r.meas;
2236 LP.p.meas = body_rates->p;
2237 LP.q.meas = body_rates->q;
2238 LP.r.meas = body_rates->r;
2239 LP.p_dot.meas_prev = LP.p_dot.meas;
2240 LP.q_dot.meas_prev = LP.q_dot.meas;
2241 LP.r_dot.meas_prev = LP.r_dot.meas;
2242 LP.p_dot.meas = (LP.p.meas - LP.p.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2243 LP.q_dot.meas = (LP.q.meas - LP.q.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2244 LP.r_dot.meas = (LP.r.meas - LP.r.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2245 LP.p_ddot.meas = (LP.p_dot.meas - LP.p_dot.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2246 LP.q_ddot.meas = (LP.q_dot.meas - LP.q_dot.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2247 LP.r_ddot.meas = (LP.r_dot.meas - LP.r_dot.meas_prev) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2248 // Update Filters of Feedbacks
2249 update_filter_on_type(&LP.ax, LP.ax.meas);
2250 update_filter_on_type(&LP.ay, LP.ay.meas);
2251 update_filter_on_type(&LP.az, LP.az.meas);
2252 update_filter_on_type(&LP.p_ddot, LP.p_ddot.meas);
2253 update_filter_on_type(&LP.q_ddot, LP.q_ddot.meas);
2254 update_filter_on_type(&LP.r_ddot, LP.r_ddot.meas);
2255 update_filter_on_type(&LP.p_dot, LP.p_dot.meas);
2256 update_filter_on_type(&LP.q_dot, LP.q_dot.meas);
2257 update_filter_on_type(&LP.r_dot, LP.r_dot.meas);
2258 update_filter_on_type(&LP.p, LP.p.meas);
2259 update_filter_on_type(&LP.q, LP.q.meas);
2260 update_filter_on_type(&LP.r, LP.r.meas);
2261 // Propagate filter for sideslip correction
2262 float accely = ACCEL_FLOAT_OF_BFP(stateGetAccelBody_i()->y);
2263 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&accely_filt, accely);
2264 float airspeed_meas = stateGetAirspeed_f();
2265 Bound(airspeed_meas, 0.0, 30.0);
2266 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&airspeed_filt, airspeed_meas);
2267}
