2270void reinit_controller(void)
2271{
2272 // Stabilization
2273 float_vect_copy(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att, 3);
2274 float_vect_copy(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d, 3);
2275 float_vect_copy(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_2d, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d, 3);
2276 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_3d, 3);
2277 eulers_zxy_des.phi = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att[0];
2278 eulers_zxy_des.theta = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att[1];
2279 eulers_zxy_des.psi = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att[2];
2280 // Guidance
2281 float_vect_copy(oneloop_nB.gui_ref.pos, oneloop_nB.gui_state.pos, 3);
2282 float_vect_copy(oneloop_nB.gui_ref.vel, oneloop_nB.gui_state.vel, 3);
2283 float_vect_copy(oneloop_nB.gui_ref.acc, oneloop_nB.gui_state.acc, 3);
2284 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.gui_ref.jer, 3);
2285 // nB controller
2286 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI.x = 0.0;
2287 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI.y = 0.0;
2288 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI.z = -1.0;
2289}
2291void oneloop_nB_init(void)
2292{
2293 oneloop_nB.half_loop = true;
2294 oneloop_nB.ctrl_type = CTRL_ANDI;
2295 init_poles();
2296 // Make sure that the dynamics are positive and non-zero
2297 for (int8_t i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2298 {
2299 act_dynamics[i] = positive_non_zero(act_dynamics[i]);
2300 }
2301 // Initialize Effectiveness matrix
2302 calc_normalization();
2303 G1G2_oneloop(oneloop_nB.ctrl_type);
2304 // Initialize filters and other variables
2305 init_all_LP();
2306 init_filter();
2307 init_controller_gains();
2308 float_vect_zero(andi_u, ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT);
2309 float_vect_zero(andi_du, ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT);
2310 float_vect_zero(andi_u_n, ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT);
2311 float_vect_zero(actuator_state_1l, ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT);
2312 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att, 3);
2313 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_d, 3);
2314 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_2d, 3);
2315 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_3d, 3);
2316 float_vect_zero(nu, ANDI_OUTPUTS);
2317 float_vect_zero(nu_n, ANDI_OUTPUTS);
2318 float_vect_zero(nav_target, 3);
2319 float_vect_zero(nav_target_new, 3);
2320 eulers_zxy_des.phi = 0.0;
2321 eulers_zxy_des.theta = 0.0;
2322 eulers_zxy_des.psi = 0.0;
2323 // nB controller
2324 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI.x = 0.0;
2325 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI.y = 0.0;
2326 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI.z = -1.0;
2327// Start telemetry
2328#if PERIODIC_TELEMETRY
2329 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_STAB_ATTITUDE, send_oneloop_nB);
2330 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_NB_CTRL, send_oneloop_nB_ctrl);
2331 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_EFF_MAT_STAB, send_eff_mat_stab_oneloop_nB);
2332 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_EFF_MAT_STAB_THRUST, send_eff_mat_stab_thrust_oneloop_nB);
2333 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_EFF_MAT_GUID, send_eff_mat_guid_oneloop_nB);
2334 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_GUIDANCE, send_guidance_oneloop_nB);
2335#ifdef PPRZ_MSG_ID_PUSH_NB
2336 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_PUSH_NB, send_PUSH_NB);
2337#endif
2338 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_DEBUG_VECT, send_oneloop_debug);
2339 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_WLS_V, send_wls_v_oneloop);
2340 register_periodic_telemetry(DefaultPeriodic, PPRZ_MSG_ID_WLS_U, send_wls_u_oneloop);
2341#endif
2342 safety_killer_trigger = false;
2343 // Log pointer to effectiveness matrix (can do only once after init)
2344}
2345
2352void oneloop_nB_enter(bool half_loop_sp, int ctrl_type)
2353{
2354 oneloop_nB.half_loop = half_loop_sp;
2355 oneloop_nB.ctrl_type = ctrl_type;
2356 psi_des_rad = eulers_zxy.psi;
2357 psi_des_deg = DegOfRad(eulers_zxy.psi);
2358 calc_normalization();
2359 G1G2_oneloop(oneloop_nB.ctrl_type);
2360 init_controller_gains();
2361 reinit_controller();
2362 safety_killer_trigger = false;
2363 spin_man_reset(); // any mode change aborts the spin manoeuvre
2364}
2365
2371void oneloop_nB_RM(bool half_loop, struct FloatVect3 PSA_des, bool in_flight_oneloop)
2372{
2373 // printf("Starting Oneloop ANDI RM\n");
2374 // Initialize some variables
2375 a_thrust = 0.0;
2376 nav_target[0] = PSA_des.x;
2377 nav_target[1] = PSA_des.y;
2378 nav_target[2] = PSA_des.z;
2379 float radio_thrust_cmd = 0.0;
2380 float radio_roll_cmd = 0.0;
2381 float radio_pitch_cmd = 0.0;
2382 float des_r = 0.0;
2383 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2384 // Need to save and convert desired position for bounding. Not sure NAV always updates this correctly.
2385 float pos_des[3];
2386 pos_des[0] = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.target.y));
2387 pos_des[1] = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.target.x));
2388 pos_des[2] = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(-POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.nav_altitude));
2389 // =======================================================================================================================================================
2390 // Some Pusher control definitions
2391 oneloop_nB.push_nB.n = 2;
2392 oneloop_nB.push_nB.max_push_cmd = max_pusher_cmd;
2393 oneloop_nB.push_nB.varepsilon = 25.0; // 10.0;
2394 oneloop_nB.push_nB.max_v_d = 1.0;
2395 oneloop_nB.push_nB.pN_d = pos_des[0];
2396 oneloop_nB.push_nB.pE_d = pos_des[1];
2397 oneloop_nB.push_nB.pN = oneloop_nB.gui_state.pos[0];
2398 oneloop_nB.push_nB.pE = oneloop_nB.gui_state.pos[1];
2399 Bound(pid_a_max, 0.05, 1.0);
2400 Bound(pid_v_max_manual, 0.1, 10.0);
2401 Bound(pid_v_max_nav, 0.1, 10.0);
2402 float PID_a_max = pid_a_max * 9.81;
2403 float acc_des[3];
2404 // Generate reference signals with reference model
2405 if (half_loop)
2406 {
2407 // printf("Half loop mode RM enabled\n");
2408 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2409 // PHI & THETA Set desired attitude with stick input
2410 radio_roll_cmd = (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_ROLL));
2411 radio_pitch_cmd = (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_PITCH));
2412 Bound(radio_roll_cmd, -MAX_PPRZ, MAX_PPRZ);
2413 Bound(radio_pitch_cmd, -MAX_PPRZ, MAX_PPRZ);
2414 eulers_zxy_des.phi = radio_roll_cmd / MAX_PPRZ * max_phi;
2415 eulers_zxy_des.theta = radio_pitch_cmd / MAX_PPRZ * max_theta;
2416 float sphi_des = sinf(eulers_zxy_des.phi);
2417 float cphi_des = cosf(eulers_zxy_des.phi);
2418 float stheta_des = sinf(eulers_zxy_des.theta);
2419 float ctheta_des = cosf(eulers_zxy_des.theta);
2420#ifdef ROTWING_EFF_SCHED_MP_dFdu
2421 if (use_push_PID)
2422 {
2423 // Desired Velocity ==============================================================
2424 if (use_push_Position)
2425 {
2426 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_d = (oneloop_nB.push_nB.pN_d - oneloop_nB.push_nB.pN) * k_K; //
2427 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_d = (oneloop_nB.push_nB.pE_d - oneloop_nB.push_nB.pE) * k_K; //
2428 }
2429 else
2430 {
2431 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_d = -radio_pitch_cmd / MAX_PPRZ * oneloop_nB.push_nB.max_v_d; //
2432 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_d = radio_roll_cmd / MAX_PPRZ * oneloop_nB.push_nB.max_v_d; //
2433 }
2434 }
2435#endif
2436 radio_body_ctrl = (fault_pitch_motors == fault_roll_motors) && (spin_man_state == SPIN_MAN_IDLE); // N/E sticks while spinning (single faulted pair)
2437 if (vel_ctrl_in_manual)
2438 {
2439 float x_dot_des[3];
2440 x_dot_des[0] = -radio_pitch_cmd / MAX_PPRZ * pid_v_max_manual; // oneloop_nB.push_nB.max_v_d;
2441 x_dot_des[1] = radio_roll_cmd / MAX_PPRZ * pid_v_max_manual; // oneloop_nB.push_nB.max_v_d;
2442 x_dot_des[2] = 0.0;
2443 if (radio_body_ctrl)
2444 {
2445 float sin_psi = sinf(eulers_zxy.psi);
2446 float cos_psi = cosf(eulers_zxy.psi);
2447 struct FloatVect3 x_dot_des_NE;
2448 x_dot_des_NE.x = x_dot_des[0] * cos_psi - x_dot_des[1] * sin_psi;
2449 x_dot_des_NE.y = x_dot_des[0] * sin_psi + x_dot_des[1] * cos_psi;
2450 x_dot_des[0] = x_dot_des_NE.x;
2451 x_dot_des[1] = x_dot_des_NE.y;
2452 }
2453 Vel_PID_ARW(x_dot_des, oneloop_nB.gui_state.vel, k_P, k_I, k_D, acc_des, PID_a_max, pid_v_max_manual);
2454 shape_vector(acc_des);
2455 eul_of_acc(acc_des, eulers_zxy.psi);
2456 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.x = acc_des[0];
2457 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.y = acc_des[1];
2458 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.z = acc_des[2];
2459 }
2460 else
2461 {
2462 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.x = -stheta_des;
2463 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.y = sphi_des * ctheta_des;
2464 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.z = -cphi_des * ctheta_des;
2465 if (radio_body_ctrl)
2466 {
2467 float sin_psi = sinf(eulers_zxy.psi);
2468 float cos_psi = cosf(eulers_zxy.psi);
2469 struct FloatVect3 nI_des_NED;
2470 nI_des_NED.x = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.x * cos_psi - oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.y * sin_psi;
2471 nI_des_NED.y = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.x * sin_psi + oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.y * cos_psi;
2472 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.x = nI_des_NED.x;
2473 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.y = nI_des_NED.y;
2474 }
2475 }
2476 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2477 // PSI Set desired Yaw rate with stick input
2478 if (!SpinQuad && spin_man_state == SPIN_MAN_IDLE) // yaw stick ignored during the spin manoeuvre
2479 {
2480 des_r = (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_YAW)) / MAX_PPRZ * max_r; // Get yaw rate from stick
2481 BoundAbs(des_r, max_r);
2482 } // Bound yaw rate
2483 float delta_psi_des_rad = des_r * dt_1l; // Integrate desired Yaw rate to get desired change in yaw
2484 float delta_psi_rad = eulers_zxy_des.psi - eulers_zxy.psi; // Calculate current yaw difference between des and actual
2485 NormRadAngle(delta_psi_rad); // Normalize the difference
2486 if (fabs(delta_psi_rad) > RadOfDeg(30.0)) // If difference is bigger than 10 deg do not further increment desired
2487 {
2488 delta_psi_des_rad = 0.0;
2489 }
2490 psi_des_rad += delta_psi_des_rad; // Incrementdesired yaw
2491 NormRadAngle(psi_des_rad);
2492 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2493 // THRUST Create commands adhoc to get actuators to the wanted level
2494 radio_thrust_cmd = (float)radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE);
2495 Bound(radio_thrust_cmd, 0.0, MAX_PPRZ);
2496 int8_t i;
2497 // To calculate the nu corrsponding to the Thrust command, plug it in the control law.
2498 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT; i++)
2499 {
2500 float den = positive_non_zero(ratio_u_un[i] * ratio_vn_v[IDX_aD]);
2501 a_thrust += (radio_thrust_cmd)*EFF_MAT_G[IDX_aD][i] / den;
2502 }
2503 a_thrust = a_thrust - ctrl_effort_model[IDX_aD]; // Subtract model disturbance
2504 ctrl_off = false; // Make sure all control on for manual takeover
2505 nu[IDX_aD] = a_thrust;
2506 }
2507 else
2508 {
2509 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2510 // PID Guidance
2511 Pos_KPID_ARW(pos_des, oneloop_nB.gui_state.pos, oneloop_nB.gui_state.vel, k_K, k_P, k_I, k_D, acc_des, PID_a_max, pid_v_max_nav);
2512 switch (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type)
2513 {
2514 case CTRL_ANDI:
2515 case CTRL_NB_ANDI:
2516 nu[IDX_aD] = (acc_des[2] - oneloop_nB.gui_state.acc[2]) * k_pos_e.k3[2];
2517 break;
2518 case CTRL_INDI:
2519 case CTRL_NB_INDI:
2520 nu[IDX_aD] = (acc_des[2] - oneloop_nB.gui_state.acc[2]);
2521 break;
2522 }
2523 temp_acc_des[0] = acc_des[0];
2524 temp_acc_des[1] = acc_des[1];
2525 temp_acc_des[2] = acc_des[2];
2526 shape_vector(acc_des);
2527 if (oneloop_nB_Z_hold)
2528 {
2529 radio_roll_cmd = (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_ROLL));
2530 radio_pitch_cmd = (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_PITCH));
2531 Bound(radio_roll_cmd, -MAX_PPRZ, MAX_PPRZ);
2532 Bound(radio_pitch_cmd, -MAX_PPRZ, MAX_PPRZ);
2533 eulers_zxy_des.phi = radio_roll_cmd / MAX_PPRZ * max_phi;
2534 eulers_zxy_des.theta = radio_pitch_cmd / MAX_PPRZ * max_theta;
2535 }
2536 else
2537 {
2538 eul_of_acc(acc_des, eulers_zxy.psi);
2539 };
2540 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.x = acc_des[0];
2541 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.y = acc_des[1];
2542 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.z = acc_des[2];
2543 // Update desired Heading (psi_des_rad) based on previous loop or changed setting
2544 if (heading_manual)
2545 {
2546 psi_des_rad = RadOfDeg(psi_des_deg);
2547 if (yaw_stick_in_auto)
2548 {
2549 psi_des_rad += (float)(radio_control_get(RADIO_YAW)) / MAX_PPRZ * max_r * dt_1l;
2550 }
2551 }
2552 else
2553 {
2554 psi_des_rad += oneloop_nB_sideslip() * dt_1l;
2555 }
2556 NormRadAngle(psi_des_rad);
2557#ifdef ROTWING_EFF_SCHED_MP_dFdu
2558 if (use_push_PID)
2559 {
2560 // Desired Velocity from Position Set Point ==============================================================
2561 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_d = (oneloop_nB.push_nB.pN_d - oneloop_nB.push_nB.pN) * k_K; //
2562 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_d = (oneloop_nB.push_nB.pE_d - oneloop_nB.push_nB.pE) * k_K; //
2563 }
2564#endif
2565 }
2566 // ============================================================================================================
2567 // Pusher Control in Either NAV or ATT
2568 // ============================================================================================================
2569#ifdef ROTWING_EFF_SCHED_MP_dFdu
2570 if (use_push_PID)
2571 {
2572 // Desired Velocity ==============================================================
2573 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&push_PID_vel_d[0], oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_d);
2574 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&push_PID_vel_d[1], oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_d);
2575 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_d_filt = push_PID_vel_d[0].o[0];
2576 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_d_filt = push_PID_vel_d[1].o[0];
2577 // Current Velocity ==============================================================
2578 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN = stateGetSpeedNed_f()->x;
2579 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE = stateGetSpeedNed_f()->y;
2580 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&push_PID_vel[0], oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN);
2581 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&push_PID_vel[1], oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE);
2582 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_filt = push_PID_vel[0].o[0];
2583 oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_filt = push_PID_vel[1].o[0];
2584 // Calculate Amplitude ===========================================================
2585 float push_delta_v[2];
2586 // push_delta_v[0] = (oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_d_filt-oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_filt);
2587 // push_delta_v[1] = (oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_d_filt-oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_filt);
2588 push_delta_v[0] = (oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN_d - oneloop_nB.push_nB.vN) * k_P;
2589 push_delta_v[1] = (oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE_d - oneloop_nB.push_nB.vE) * k_P;
2590 // Allocation on Integral Solution ===============================================
2591 float push_delta_v_norm = sqrtf(push_delta_v[0] * push_delta_v[0] + push_delta_v[1] * push_delta_v[1]);
2592 float r_int_sol = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[2];
2593 BoundAbs(r_int_sol, 5.0);
2594 float push_cmd_A = fabs(r_int_sol) * sqrtf((float)oneloop_nB.push_nB.n) / (2.0 * sqrtf((float)M_PI) * RW.mP.dFdu / RW.m) * push_delta_v_norm;
2595 Bound(push_cmd_A, 0.0f, oneloop_nB.push_nB.max_push_cmd);
2596 oneloop_nB.push_nB.push_cmd = push_cmd_A * pusher_cmd_fun(push_delta_v[0], push_delta_v[1], oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[2], oneloop_nB.sta_state.att[2], oneloop_nB.push_nB.varepsilon, oneloop_nB.push_nB.n);
2597 commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER] = (int16_t)oneloop_nB.push_nB.push_cmd;
2598 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.x = 0.0;
2599 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.y = 0.0;
2600 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des.z = -1.0;
2601 }
2602 else
2603 {
2604 // Pusher off when not used (nothing else commands it, otherwise it would keep its last value)
2605 oneloop_nB.push_nB.push_cmd = 0.0;
2606 commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_PUSHER] = 0;
2607 }
2608#endif
2609 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2610 if (!in_flight_oneloop)
2611 {
2612 psi_des_rad = eulers_zxy.psi;
2613 } // Reset if not flying
2614 // Heading is not controlled while spinning (manoeuvre or motor fault in nB): keep the desired heading on the
2615 // actual one, so that heading control resumes without a jump (up to 180 deg) when the fault is removed
2616 bool nb_ctrl_rm = (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI);
2617 if (spin_man_state != SPIN_MAN_IDLE || (nb_ctrl_rm && (fault_pitch_motors != fault_roll_motors)))
2618 {
2619 psi_des_rad = eulers_zxy.psi;
2620 psi_des_deg = DegOfRad(psi_des_rad);
2621 }
2622 eulers_zxy_des.psi = psi_des_rad;
2623 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2624 // Set and Save the desired attitude and run the attitude RM
2625 float att_des[3] = {eulers_zxy_des.phi, eulers_zxy_des.theta, eulers_zxy_des.psi};
2626#define OVERRIDE_ATT_RM
2627#ifdef OVERRIDE_ATT_RM
2628 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att, 3);
2629 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_d, 3);
2630 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_2d, 3);
2631 float_vect_zero(oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_3d, 3);
2632 oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att[0] = att_des[0];
2633 oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att[1] = att_des[1];
2634 oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att[2] = att_des[2];
2635#else
2636 static float psi_vec[4] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0}; // Vector to overwrite the Yaw reference in the attitude controller
2637 rm_3rd_attitude(dt_1l, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_2d, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_3d, att_des, false, psi_vec, k_att_rm.k1, k_att_rm.k2, k_att_rm.k3, sta_bounds);
2638#endif
2639 rm_3rd_nI(dt_1l, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_d, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_2d, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_3d, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_des, k_att_rm.k1, k_att_rm.k2, k_att_rm.k3);
2640 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2641}
2642
2649void oneloop_nB_run(bool in_flight, bool half_loop, struct FloatVect3 PSA_des)
2650{
2651 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2652 // At beginnig of the loop: (1) Register Attitude, (2) Initialize gains of RM and EC, (3) Calculate Normalization of Actuators Signals, (4) Propagate Actuator Model, (5) Update effectiveness matrix
2653 float_eulers_of_quat_zxy(&eulers_zxy, stateGetNedToBodyQuat_f());
2654 init_controller_gains();
2655 calc_normalization();
2656 get_act_state_oneloop();
2657 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2658 // If drone is not on the ground use incremental law
2659 bool in_flight_oneloop = false;
2660 if (in_flight)
2661 {
2662 in_flight_oneloop = true;
2663 }
2664 if (ONELOOP_NB_DEBUG_MODE)
2665 {
2666 in_flight_oneloop = true;
2667 }
2668 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2669 // Calculate disturbance (model control effort) based on the model
2670 oneloop_calc_model_disturbance(in_flight);
2671 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2672 // Register the state of the drone in the variables used in RM and EC
2673 // (1) Attitude related
2674 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att[0] = eulers_zxy.phi;
2675 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att[1] = eulers_zxy.theta;
2676 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att[2] = eulers_zxy.psi;
2677 oneloop_nB_propagate_filters(); // needs to be after update of attitude vector
2678 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[0] = LP.p.out;
2679 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[1] = LP.q.out;
2680 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[2] = LP.r.out;
2681 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d[0] = LP.p_dot.out;
2682 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d[1] = LP.q_dot.out;
2683 oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d[2] = LP.r_dot.out;
2684 // (2) Position related
2685 oneloop_nB.gui_state.pos[0] = stateGetPositionNed_f()->x;
2686 oneloop_nB.gui_state.pos[1] = stateGetPositionNed_f()->y;
2687 oneloop_nB.gui_state.pos[2] = stateGetPositionNed_f()->z;
2688 oneloop_nB.gui_state.vel[0] = stateGetSpeedNed_f()->x;
2689 oneloop_nB.gui_state.vel[1] = stateGetSpeedNed_f()->y;
2690 oneloop_nB.gui_state.vel[2] = stateGetSpeedNed_f()->z;
2691 oneloop_nB.gui_state.acc[0] = LP.ax.out;
2692 oneloop_nB.gui_state.acc[1] = LP.ay.out;
2693 oneloop_nB.gui_state.acc[2] = LP.az.out;
2694 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2695 // Calculated feedforward signal for yaw control
2696 g2_ff = 0.0;
2697 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT; i++)
2698 {
2699 switch (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type)
2700 {
2701 case (CTRL_ANDI):
2702 case (CTRL_NB_ANDI):
2703 g2_ff += G2_RW[i] * act_dyn_ctrl[i] * (andi_u[i] - u_filt[i].o[0]);
2704 break;
2705 case (CTRL_INDI):
2706 case (CTRL_NB_INDI):
2707 g2_ff += G2_RW[i] * (andi_u[i] - u_filt[i].o[0]);
2708 break;
2709 default:
2710 break;
2711 }
2712 }
2713 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2714 // Spin protection / manoeuvre: validate parameters, then run the manoeuvre (it sets fault_pitch_motors)
2715 spin_prot_bound_params(); // guarantees spin_prot_max_rate - spin_prot_start_rate >= spin_prot_min_gap > 0
2716 spin_man_update(in_flight, (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI));
2717 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2718 // Run the Reference Model (RM)
2719 oneloop_nB_RM(half_loop, PSA_des, in_flight_oneloop);
2720 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2721 // Calculate new nB states based on updated RM for nI
2722 oneloop_nB_calc_nB_states();
2723 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2724 // Update Effectiveness matrix based on the control type
2725 G1G2_oneloop(oneloop_nB.ctrl_type);
2726 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2727 // Attitude EC
2728 float att_jerk_des[3];
2729 float nu_stab[3] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
2730 float att_des[3] = {eulers_zxy_des.phi, eulers_zxy_des.theta, eulers_zxy_des.psi};
2731 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.mu_B.x = 0.0;
2732 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.mu_B.y = 0.0;
2733 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.mu_B.z = -1.0;
2734
2735 float ctrl_effort_model_att[3] = {ctrl_effort_model[IDX_ap], ctrl_effort_model[IDX_aq], ctrl_effort_model[IDX_ar]};
2736 float dummy1[3] = {1.0, 1.0, 1.0};
2737 float dummy0[3] = {0.0, 0.0, 0.0};
2738 struct FloatVect3 nB_2d_FV3;
2739 nB_2d_FV3.x = nB_2d_filt[0].o[0];
2740 nB_2d_FV3.y = nB_2d_filt[1].o[0];
2741 nB_2d_FV3.z = nB_2d_filt[2].o[0];
2742 switch (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type)
2743 {
2744 case CTRL_ANDI:
2745 ec_3rd_att(att_jerk_des, att_des, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_2d, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_3d, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, k_att_e.k3, sta_bounds, ctrl_effort_model_att);
2746 nB_EC(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.mu_B, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, dummy1, ctrl_effort_model_att, nB_jerk_des);
2747 nu_stab[0] = att_jerk_des[0];
2748 nu_stab[1] = att_jerk_des[1];
2749 nu_stab[2] = att_jerk_des[2];
2750 SpinQuad_overwrite(k_att_e.k3[2], ctrl_effort_model[IDX_ar], &nu_stab[2]);
2751 break;
2752 case CTRL_INDI:
2753 ec_3rd_att(att_jerk_des, att_des, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_2d, dummy0, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, dummy1, sta_bounds, ctrl_effort_model_att);
2754 nu_stab[0] = att_jerk_des[0];
2755 nu_stab[1] = att_jerk_des[1];
2756 nu_stab[2] = att_jerk_des[2];
2757 SpinQuad_overwrite(1.0, ctrl_effort_model[IDX_ar], &nu_stab[2]);
2758 break;
2759 case CTRL_NB_ANDI:
2760 ec_3rd_att(att_jerk_des, att_des, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_2d, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_3d, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, k_att_e.k3, sta_bounds, ctrl_effort_model_att);
2761 // nB_EC(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.mu_B, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, k_att_e.k3, ctrl_effort_model_att, nB_jerk_des);
2762 nB_EC(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d, nB_2d_FV3, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.mu_B, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, k_att_e.k3, ctrl_effort_model_att, nB_jerk_des);
2763 nu_stab[0] = nB_jerk_des[0] - nB_3d_state_filt[0].o[0]; // state_term[0];
2764 nu_stab[1] = nB_jerk_des[1] - nB_3d_state_filt[1].o[0]; // state_term[1];
2765 nu_stab[2] = att_jerk_des[2];
2766 SpinQuad_overwrite(k_att_e.k3[2], ctrl_effort_model[IDX_ar], &nu_stab[2]);
2767 break;
2768 case CTRL_NB_INDI:
2769 ec_3rd_att(att_jerk_des, att_des, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_ref.att_2d, dummy0, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d, oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, dummy1, sta_bounds, ctrl_effort_model_att);
2770 // nB_EC(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.mu_B, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, dummy1, ctrl_effort_model_att, nB_jerk_des);
2771 nB_EC(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d, nB_2d_FV3, oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.mu_B, k_att_e.k1, k_att_e.k2, dummy1, ctrl_effort_model_att, nB_jerk_des);
2772 nu_stab[0] = nB_jerk_des[0];
2773 nu_stab[1] = nB_jerk_des[1];
2774 nu_stab[2] = att_jerk_des[2];
2775 SpinQuad_overwrite(1.0, ctrl_effort_model[IDX_ar], &nu_stab[2]);
2776 break;
2777 }
2778 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2779 // Set Pseudo-control inputs nu based on EC outputs
2780 if (half_loop && radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE) < 200)
2781 {
2782 nu[IDX_ap] = 0.0;
2783 nu[IDX_aq] = 0.0;
2784 nu[IDX_ar] = 0.0;
2785 }
2786 else
2787 {
2788 nu[IDX_ap] = nu_stab[0];
2789 nu[IDX_aq] = nu_stab[1];
2790 nu[IDX_ar] = nu_stab[2] + g2_ff;
2791 }
2792 nu[IDX_aD] = nu[IDX_aD] + ctrl_effort_model[IDX_aD];
2793 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2794 // Manipulate Pseudo control vecotors for state compensation and axis dropping
2795 // BoundAbs(nu[5], n_array[5]*coupling_factor[5]); //FIXME UNCOMMENT ME
2796 drop_axis();
2797 oneloop_nB_state_compensation(state_compensation_on);
2798 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2799 // Set the WLS settings
2800 set_WLS_settings();
2801 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2802 // WLS Control Allocator
2803 normalize_nu();
2804 wls_alloc(&WLS_one_p, bwls_1l, 0, 0, 10);
2805 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2806 // Save the commands to the actuators
2807 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2808 {
2809 andi_u_n[i] = WLS_one_p.u[i];
2810 andi_u[i] = (float)(andi_u_n[i] * ratio_u_un[i]);
2811 Bound(andi_u[i], act_min[i], act_max[i]);
2812 if ((actuator_state_1l[i]> safety_killer_cutoff||andi_u[i] > 8500.0) && use_safety_killer)
2813 {
2814 safety_killer_trigger = true;
2815 }
2816 }
2817 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2818 // Handle fault static commands
2819 // The static fault commands (and the spin trim) are only used by the nB controllers
2820 bool nb_ctrl = (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI);
2821 float temp_thrust = 0.0;
2822 static int counter_afc = 0;
2823 float min_fault_mot = 0.0;
2824 float time_afc = 30.0;
2825 float m_afc = (min_fault_mot - max_fault_mot) / (time_afc * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY);
2826 if (auto_fault_cmd)
2827 {
2828 temp_thrust = m_afc * (float)counter_afc + max_fault_mot;
2829 counter_afc = counter_afc + 1;
2830 if (counter_afc > time_afc * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY)
2831 {
2832 counter_afc = 0;
2833 auto_fault_cmd = false;
2834 }
2835 }
2836 else
2837 {
2838 temp_thrust = (float)radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE) - delta_fault;
2839 counter_afc = 0;
2840 }
2841 Bound(temp_thrust, 0.0, max_fault_mot);
2842 // Yaw spin envelope protection: linearly mix the static command with the max command
2843 // depending on how close the (filtered) yaw rate is to the max allowed yaw rate
2844 float abs_r = fabsf(oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[2]); // parameters bounded at the start of oneloop_nB_run
2845 spin_prot_ratio = (abs_r - spin_prot_start_rate) / (spin_prot_max_rate - spin_prot_start_rate);
2846 Bound(spin_prot_ratio, 0.0, 1.0);
2847 // Spin trim: integrate up while the envelope is active, bleed off below the release rate, hold in between.
2848 // Only active with a single faulted pair in flight, reset otherwise (and during the auto fault ramp).
2849 bool single_fault = nb_ctrl && (fault_pitch_motors != fault_roll_motors);
2850 if (spin_man_state == SPIN_MAN_DOWN_SLOW)
2851 {
2852 // Spin manoeuvre slowing down: open loop trim increase, no bleed
2853 spin_trim += spin_man_trim_rate / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2854 Bound(spin_trim, 0.0, spin_prot_max_cmd);
2855 }
2856 else if (spin_trim_on && single_fault && in_flight && !auto_fault_cmd)
2857 {
2858 if (spin_prot_ratio > 0.0 && (temp_thrust + spin_trim) < spin_prot_max_cmd) // anti-windup
2859 {
2860 spin_trim += spin_trim_rate * spin_prot_ratio / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2861 }
2862 else if (abs_r < spin_trim_release_rate)
2863 {
2864 spin_trim -= spin_trim_bleed_rate / PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
2865 }
2866 Bound(spin_trim, 0.0, spin_prot_max_cmd);
2867 }
2868 else
2869 {
2870 spin_trim = 0.0;
2871 }
2872 // spin_prot_max_cmd is the single ceiling for the faulted motors: base + trim is cut to it,
2873 // and the envelope blends towards it (so the blend can only raise the command)
2874 temp_thrust += spin_trim;
2875 Bound(temp_thrust, 0.0, spin_prot_max_cmd);
2876 temp_thrust = (1.0 - spin_prot_ratio) * temp_thrust + spin_prot_ratio * spin_prot_max_cmd;
2877 if (fault_pitch_motors && !fault_roll_motors && nb_ctrl)
2878 {
2879 andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT] = temp_thrust;
2880 andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK] = temp_thrust;
2881 }
2882 else if (fault_roll_motors && !fault_pitch_motors && nb_ctrl)
2883 {
2884 andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT] = temp_thrust;
2885 andi_u[COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT] = temp_thrust;
2886 }
2887 // Both pairs faulted is not a supported case: it is treated as no fault (normal operation)
2888 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2889 // Spin manoeuvre: bumpless transfer of the selected pair. andi_u already holds the new source
2890 // (static fault cmd when faulted, allocator output when not), blend it from the cmd held at the transition
2891 if (spin_man_alpha < 1.0)
2892 {
2893 for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++)
2894 {
2895 andi_u[spin_man_mot[k]] = (1.0 - spin_man_alpha) * spin_man_u_hold[k] + spin_man_alpha * andi_u[spin_man_mot[k]];
2896 }
2897 }
2898 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT; i++)
2899 {
2900 spin_man_u_last[i] = andi_u[i];
2901 }
2902 // ======================================================================================================================================================
2903 /*Commit the actuator command*/
2904 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT; i++)
2905 {
2906#if ONELOOP_NB_DEBUG_MODE
2907 if (i == TestMotorIDX)
2908 {
2909 commands[i] = (int16_t)radio_control_get(RADIO_THROTTLE);
2910 }
2911 else
2912 {
2913 commands[i] = (int16_t)(0.0);
2914 }
2915#else
2916 if (use_safety_killer && safety_killer_trigger)
2917 {
2918 commands[i] = (int16_t)0.0;
2919 }
2920 else
2921 {
2922 commands[i] = (int16_t)andi_u[i];
2923 }
2924#endif
2925 }
2926
2927 commands[COMMAND_THRUST] = (commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT] + commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT] + commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK] + commands[COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT]) / num_thrusters_oneloop;
2928 autopilot.throttle = commands[COMMAND_THRUST];
2929 stabilization.cmd[COMMAND_THRUST] = commands[COMMAND_THRUST];
2930 if (heading_manual)
2931 {
2932 psi_des_deg = DegOfRad(psi_des_rad);
2933 }
2934 stabilization.cmd[COMMAND_ROLL] = (int16_t)(DegOfRad(eulers_zxy_des.phi) * MAX_PPRZ / DegOfRad(max_phi));
2935 stabilization.cmd[COMMAND_PITCH] = (int16_t)(DegOfRad(eulers_zxy_des.theta) * MAX_PPRZ / DegOfRad(max_theta));
2936 stabilization.cmd[COMMAND_YAW] = (int16_t)(psi_des_deg * MAX_PPRZ / 180.0);
2937}
2938
2939//=========================================================================================================================================================
2941//==========================================================================================================================================================
2942void get_act_state_oneloop(void)
2943{
2944 int8_t i;
2945 float prev_actuator_state_1l;
2946 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2947 {
2948 if (i < ANDI_NUM_ACT)
2949 {
2950 prev_actuator_state_1l = actuator_state_1l[i];
2951 actuator_state_1l[i] = prev_actuator_state_1l + act_dynamics_d[i] * (andi_u[i] - prev_actuator_state_1l);
2952 if (!autopilot_get_motors_on())
2953 {
2954 actuator_state_1l[i] = 0.0;
2955 }
2956 Bound(actuator_state_1l[i], act_min[i], act_max[i]);
2957 }
2958 else
2959 {
2960 actuator_state_1l[i] = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att[i - ANDI_NUM_ACT];
2961 }
2962 }
2963}
2964//=========================================================================================================================================================
2969//=========================================================================================================================================================
2970void G1G2_oneloop(int ctrl_type)
2971{
2972 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
2973 {
2974 bwls_1l[i] = EFF_MAT_G[i];
2975 }
2976 float scaler = 1.0;
2977 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
2978 {
2979 switch (ctrl_type)
2980 {
2981 case (CTRL_ANDI):
2982 case (CTRL_NB_ANDI):
2983 scaler = act_dyn_ctrl[i] * ratio_u_un[i];
2984 break;
2985 case (CTRL_INDI):
2986 case (CTRL_NB_INDI):
2987 scaler = ratio_u_un[i];
2988 break;
2989 }
2990 for (int j = 0; j < ANDI_OUTPUTS; j++)
2991 {
2992 EFF_MAT_G[j][i] = EFF_MAT_RW[2 + j][i] * scaler * ratio_vn_v[j]; // EFF_MAT_RW has extra entries for North and EAST
2993 }
2994 }
2995 //=========================================================================================================================================================
2996 // If using an nB controller, convert the Eff matrix to the nB axes
2997 switch (ctrl_type)
2998 {
2999 case (CTRL_NB_ANDI):
3000 case (CTRL_NB_INDI):
3001 {
3002 for (int j = 0; j < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; j++)
3003 {
3004 float temp_ap_j = -EFF_MAT_G[IDX_aq][j] * nB_filt[2].o[0]; //+ EFF_MAT_G[IDX_ar][j]*nB_filt[1].o[0] ;
3005 float temp_aq_j = EFF_MAT_G[IDX_ap][j] * nB_filt[2].o[0]; //- EFF_MAT_G[IDX_ar][j]*nB_filt[0].o[0];
3006 EFF_MAT_G[IDX_ap][j] = temp_ap_j;
3007 EFF_MAT_G[IDX_aq][j] = temp_aq_j;
3008 }
3009 //=========================================================================================================================================================
3010 // Only a single faulted pair is supported, both pairs faulted is treated as no fault
3011 if (fault_pitch_motors && !fault_roll_motors)
3012 {
3013 EFF_MAT_G[IDX_ar][COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT] = 0.0;
3014 EFF_MAT_G[IDX_ar][COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT] = 0.0;
3015 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
3016 {
3017 EFF_MAT_G[i][COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT] = 0.0;
3018 EFF_MAT_G[i][COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK] = 0.0;
3019 }
3020 }
3021 if (fault_roll_motors && !fault_pitch_motors)
3022 {
3023 EFF_MAT_G[IDX_ar][COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT] = 0.0;
3024 EFF_MAT_G[IDX_ar][COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK] = 0.0;
3025 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
3026 {
3027 EFF_MAT_G[i][COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT] = 0.0;
3028 EFF_MAT_G[i][COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT] = 0.0;
3029 }
3030 }
3031#ifdef COMMAND_AILERONS
3032 if (fault_ailerons)
3033 {
3034 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
3035 {
3036 EFF_MAT_G[i][COMMAND_AILERONS] = 0.0;
3037 }
3038 }
3039#endif
3040 }
3041 break;
3042 }
3043 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
3044 {
3045 act_dyn_ctrl[i] = act_dynamics[i];
3046 }
3047}
3048//=========================================================================================================================================================
3050//=========================================================================================================================================================
3051void calc_normalization(void)
3052{
3053 int8_t i;
3054 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
3055 {
3056 act_dynamics_d[i] = 1.0 - exp(-act_dynamics[i] * dt_1l);
3057 Bound(act_dynamics_d[i], 0.00001, 1.0);
3058 Bound(act_max[i], 0, MAX_PPRZ);
3059 Bound(act_min[i], -MAX_PPRZ, 0);
3060 float ratio_numerator = act_max[i] - act_min[i];
3061 ratio_numerator = positive_non_zero(ratio_numerator); // make sure numerator is non-zero
3062 float ratio_denominator = act_max_norm[i] - act_min_norm[i];
3063 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(ratio_denominator); // make sure denominator is non-zero
3064 ratio_u_un[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
3065 ratio_u_un[i] = positive_non_zero(ratio_u_un[i]); // make sure ratio is not zero
3066 }
3067 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
3068 {
3069 float ratio_numerator = positive_non_zero(nu_norm_max);
3070 float ratio_denominator = 1.0;
3071 switch (i)
3072 {
3073 case (IDX_aD):
3074 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(max_j_lin);
3075 ratio_vn_v[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
3076 break;
3077 case (IDX_ap):
3078 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(sta_bounds.att_3d[0]);
3079 ratio_vn_v[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
3080 break;
3081 case (IDX_aq):
3082 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(sta_bounds.att_3d[1]);
3083 ratio_vn_v[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
3084 break;
3085 case (IDX_ar):
3086 ratio_denominator = positive_non_zero(sta_bounds.att_3d[2]);
3087 ratio_vn_v[i] = ratio_numerator / ratio_denominator;
3088 break;
3089 }
3090 }
3091}

3094//=========================================================================================================================================================
3095void normalize_nu(void)
3096{
3097 int8_t i;
3098 for (i = 0; i < ANDI_OUTPUTS; i++)
3099 {
3100 // printf("ratio_vn_v[%d] = %f \n",i,ratio_vn_v[i]);
3101 nu_n[i] = nu[i] * ratio_vn_v[i];
3102 WLS_one_p.v[i] = nu_n[i];
3103 }

3108void oneloop_from_nav(bool in_flight)
3109{
3110 if (!in_flight)
3111 {
3112 oneloop_nB_enter(false, oneloop_nB.ctrl_type);
3113 }
3114 struct FloatVect3 PSA_des;
3115 PSA_des.x = stateGetPositionNed_f()->x;
3116 PSA_des.y = stateGetPositionNed_f()->y;
3117 PSA_des.z = stateGetPositionNed_f()->z;
3118 // int rm_order_h = 3;
3119 // int rm_order_v = 3;
3120 // Oneloop controller wants desired targets and handles reference generation internally
3121 switch (nav.setpoint_mode)
3122 {
3123 case NAV_SETPOINT_MODE_POS:
3124 PSA_des.x = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.target.y));
3125 PSA_des.y = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.target.x));
3126 // rm_order_h = 3;
3127 break;
3128 case NAV_SETPOINT_MODE_SPEED:
3129 PSA_des.x = SPEED_FLOAT_OF_BFP(SPEED_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.speed.y));
3130 PSA_des.y = SPEED_FLOAT_OF_BFP(SPEED_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.speed.x));
3131 // rm_order_h = 2;
3132 break;
3133 }
3134 switch (nav.vertical_mode)
3135 {
3136 case NAV_VERTICAL_MODE_ALT:
3137 PSA_des.z = POS_FLOAT_OF_BFP(-POS_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.nav_altitude));
3138 // rm_order_v = 3;
3139 break;
3140 case NAV_VERTICAL_MODE_CLIMB:
3141 PSA_des.z = SPEED_FLOAT_OF_BFP(-SPEED_BFP_OF_REAL(nav.climb));
3142 // rm_order_v = 2;
3143 break;
3144 }
3145 oneloop_nB_run(in_flight, false, PSA_des);
3146}
3147//=========================================================================================================================================================
3149//=========================================================================================================================================================
3150float oneloop_nB_sideslip(void)
3151{
3152 // Coordinated turn
3153 // feedforward estimate angular rotation omega = g*tan(phi)/v
3154 float omega = 0.0;
3155 float airspeed_turn = airspeed_filt.o[0];
3156 Bound(airspeed_turn, 1.0f, 30.0f);
3157 // Use the current roll angle to determine the corresponding heading rate of change.
3158 float coordinated_turn_roll = eulers_zxy.phi;
3159 // Prevent flipping
3160 if ((eulers_zxy.theta > 0.0f) && (fabs(eulers_zxy.phi) < eulers_zxy.theta))
3161 {
3162 // printf("Preventing flipping\n");
3163 coordinated_turn_roll = ((eulers_zxy.phi > 0.0f) - (eulers_zxy.phi < 0.0f)) * eulers_zxy.theta;
3164 }
3165 BoundAbs(coordinated_turn_roll, max_phi);
3166 omega = g / airspeed_turn * tanf(coordinated_turn_roll);
3167#ifdef FWD_SIDESLIP_GAIN
3168 // Add sideslip correction
3169 omega -= accely_filt.o[0] * fwd_sideslip_gain;
3170#endif
3171 return omega;
3172}

3180//=========================================================================================================================================================
3181// Some functions for Airspeed Control DEPRECIATED
3182//=========================================================================================================================================================
3183void reshape_wind(void)
3184{
3185 float psi = eulers_zxy.psi;
3186 float cpsi = cosf(psi);
3187 float spsi = sinf(psi);
3188 float airspeed = airspeed_filt.o[0];
3189 struct FloatVect2 NT_v_NE = {nav_target[0], nav_target[1]}; // Nav target in North and East frame
3190 struct FloatVect2 airspeed_v = {cpsi * airspeed, spsi * airspeed};
3191 struct FloatVect2 windspeed;
3192 struct FloatVect2 groundspeed = {oneloop_nB.gui_state.vel[0], oneloop_nB.gui_state.vel[1]};
3193 struct FloatVect2 des_as_NE;
3194 struct FloatVect2 des_as_B;
3195 struct FloatVect2 des_acc_B;
3196 VECT2_DIFF(windspeed, groundspeed, airspeed_v); // Wind speed in North and East frame
3197 VECT2_DIFF(des_as_NE, NT_v_NE, windspeed); // Desired airspeed in North and East frame
3198 float norm_des_as = FLOAT_VECT2_NORM(des_as_NE);
3199 gi_unbounded_airspeed_sp = norm_des_as;
3200 // Check if some minimum airspeed is desired (e.g. to prevent stall)
3201 if (norm_des_as < min_as)
3202 {
3203 norm_des_as = min_as;
3204 }
3205 nav_target_new[0] = NT_v_NE.x;
3206 nav_target_new[1] = NT_v_NE.y;
3207 // if the desired airspeed is larger than the max airspeed or we are in force forward reshape gs des to cancel wind and fly at max airspeed
3208 if ((norm_des_as > max_as) || (force_forward))
3209 {
3210 float groundspeed_factor = 0.0f;
3211 if (FLOAT_VECT2_NORM(windspeed) < max_as)
3212 {
3213 float av = NT_v_NE.x * NT_v_NE.x + NT_v_NE.y * NT_v_NE.y; // norm squared of nav target
3214 float bv = -2.f * (windspeed.x * NT_v_NE.x + windspeed.y * NT_v_NE.y);
3215 float cv = windspeed.x * windspeed.x + windspeed.y * windspeed.y - max_as * max_as;
3216 float dv = bv * bv - 4.0f * av * cv;
3217 // dv can only be positive, but just in case
3218 if (dv < 0.0f)
3219 {
3220 dv = fabsf(dv);
3221 }
3222 float d_sqrt = sqrtf(dv);
3223 groundspeed_factor = (-bv + d_sqrt) / (2.0f * av);
3224 }
3225 des_as_NE.x = groundspeed_factor * NT_v_NE.x - windspeed.x;
3226 des_as_NE.y = groundspeed_factor * NT_v_NE.y - windspeed.y;
3227 NT_v_NE.x = groundspeed_factor * NT_v_NE.x;
3228 NT_v_NE.y = groundspeed_factor * NT_v_NE.y;
3229 norm_des_as = max_as;
3230 }
3231 des_as_B.x = norm_des_as; // Desired airspeed in body x frame
3232 des_as_B.y = 0.0; // Desired airspeed in body y frame
3233 if (((airspeed > ONELOOP_NB_AIRSPEED_SWITCH_THRESHOLD) && (norm_des_as > (ONELOOP_NB_AIRSPEED_SWITCH_THRESHOLD + 2.0f))) || (force_forward))
3234 {
3235 float delta_psi = atan2f(des_as_NE.y, des_as_NE.x) - psi;
3236 FLOAT_ANGLE_NORMALIZE(delta_psi);
3237 des_acc_B.y = delta_psi * 5.0; // gih_params.heading_bank_gain;
3238 des_acc_B.x = (des_as_B.x - airspeed) * k_pos_rm.k2[0]; // gih_params.speed_gain;
3239 acc_body_bound(&des_acc_B, max_a_nav); // Scale down side acceleration if norm is too large
3240 nav_target_new[0] = cpsi * des_acc_B.x - spsi * des_acc_B.y;
3241 nav_target_new[1] = spsi * des_acc_B.x + cpsi * des_acc_B.y;
3242 }
3243 else
3244 {
3245 nav_target_new[0] = (NT_v_NE.x - groundspeed.x) * k_pos_rm.k2[0];
3246 nav_target_new[1] = (NT_v_NE.y - groundspeed.y) * k_pos_rm.k2[1];
3247 }
3248 vect_bound_nd(nav_target_new, max_a_nav, 2);
3249}

3309void oneloop_nB_state_compensation(bool state_compensation_on)
3310{
3311 float p = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[0];
3312 float q = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[1];
3313 float r = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[2];
3314 float p_dot = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d[0];
3315 float q_dot = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d[1];
3316 float r_dot = oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d[2];
3317 if (state_compensation_on)
3318 {
3319 nu[IDX_ap] -= (r * q_dot + q * r_dot) * (RW.I.yy - RW.I.zz) / RW.I.xx; // Roll
3320 nu[IDX_aq] -= (r * p_dot + p * r_dot) * (RW.I.zz - RW.I.xx) / RW.I.yy; // Pitch
3321 }
3322}

3348void set_WLS_settings(void)
3349{
3350 for (int i = 0; i < ANDI_NUM_ACT_TOT; i++)
3351 {
3352 switch (i)
3353 {
3354 case COMMAND_MOTOR_FRONT:
3355 case COMMAND_MOTOR_RIGHT:
3356 case COMMAND_MOTOR_BACK:
3357 case COMMAND_MOTOR_LEFT:
3358#ifdef COMMAND_AILERONS
3359 case COMMAND_AILERONS:
3360#endif
3361 WLS_one_p.Wu[i] = Wu_backup[i];
3362 WLS_one_p.u_min[i] = (act_min[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
3363 WLS_one_p.u_pref[i] = (u_pref[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
3364 WLS_one_p.u_max[i] = (act_max[i]) / ratio_u_un[i];
3365 break;
3366 }
3367 }
3368 bool IN_QUAD = true;
3369#ifdef COMMAND_ROT_MECH
3370 if (RW.skew.deg > 70.0)
3371 {
3372 IN_QUAD = false;
3373 }
3374#endif
3375 // Start from the nominal weights every loop, the single fault cases below only override what they change.
3376 // This way no weight or drop flag is carried over when switching from one faulted pair to the other.
3377 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ap] = Wv_backup[IDX_ap];
3378 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_aq] = Wv_backup[IDX_aq];
3379 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ar] = Wv_backup[IDX_ar];
3380 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_aD] = Wv_backup[IDX_aD];
3381 drop_roll = false;
3382 drop_pitch = false;
3383 drop_yaw = false;
3384 drop_aD = false;
3385 // Only a single faulted pair is supported, both pairs faulted (or no fault) keeps the nominal weights
3386 if (fault_pitch_motors && !fault_roll_motors && fault_ailerons && IN_QUAD && (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI))
3387 {
3388 /* TRUE FALSE TRUE, QUAD → 0 1 0, 1 0 1 */
3389 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ap] = 0.0;
3390 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_aq] = Wv_backup[IDX_aq];
3391 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ar] = 0.0;
3392 drop_roll = true;
3393 drop_pitch = false;
3394 drop_yaw = true;
3395 }
3396 else if (fault_pitch_motors && !fault_roll_motors && fault_ailerons && !IN_QUAD && (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI))
3397 {
3398 /* TRUE FALSE TRUE, skew90 → 1 0 0, 0 1 1 */
3399 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ap] = Wv_backup[IDX_ap];
3400 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_aq] = 0.0;
3401 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ar] = 0.0;
3402 drop_roll = false;
3403 drop_pitch = true;
3404 drop_yaw = true;
3405 }
3406 else if (!fault_pitch_motors && fault_roll_motors && fault_ailerons && IN_QUAD && (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI))
3407 {
3408 /* FALSE TRUE TRUE, QUAD → 1 0 0, 0 1 1 */
3409 // Only FRONT/BACK remain and they give pitch moment, which in nB is the IDX_ap row: keep ap, drop aq
3410 // (same as the FALSE TRUE FALSE, QUAD case: the ailerons have no effect in quad)
3411 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ap] = Wv_backup[IDX_ap];
3412 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_aq] = 0.0;
3413 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ar] = 0.0;
3414 drop_roll = false;
3415 drop_pitch = true;
3416 drop_yaw = true;
3417 }
3418 else if (!fault_pitch_motors && fault_roll_motors && fault_ailerons && !IN_QUAD && (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI))
3419 {
3420 /* FALSE TRUE TRUE, skew90 → 1 0 0, 0 1 1 */
3421 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ap] = Wv_backup[IDX_ap];
3422 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_aq] = 0.0;
3423 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ar] = 0.0;
3424 drop_roll = false;
3425 drop_pitch = true;
3426 drop_yaw = true;
3427 }
3428 else if (fault_pitch_motors && !fault_roll_motors && !fault_ailerons && IN_QUAD && (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI))
3429 {
3430 /* TRUE FALSE FALSE, QUAD → 0 1 0, 1 0 1 */
3431 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ap] = 0.0;
3432 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_aq] = Wv_backup[IDX_aq];
3433 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ar] = 0.0;
3434 drop_roll = true;
3435 drop_pitch = false;
3436 drop_yaw = true;
3437 }
3438 else if (fault_pitch_motors && !fault_roll_motors && !fault_ailerons && !IN_QUAD && (oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_INDI || oneloop_nB.ctrl_type == CTRL_NB_ANDI))
3439 {
3440 /* TRUE FALSE FALSE, skew90 → 1 1 0, 0 0 1 */
3441 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ap] = Wv_backup[IDX_ap];
3442 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_aq] = Wv_backup[IDX_aq];
3443 WLS_one_p.Wv[IDX_ar] = 0.0;
3444 drop_roll = false;

3469//=========================================================================================================================================================
3471void oneloop_nB_calc_nB_states(void)
3472{
3473 struct FloatRMat *LBI = stateGetNedToBodyRMat_f();
3474 struct FloatRMat Omega_B;
3475 struct FloatRMat Omega_B_dot;
3476 struct FloatRMat Omega_B_ddot;
3477
3478 struct FloatVect3 pqr;
3479 struct FloatVect3 pqr_dot;
3480 struct FloatVect3 pqr_ddot;
3481
3482 struct FloatVect3 A;
3483 struct FloatVect3 B;
3484 struct FloatVect3 C;
3485 struct FloatVect3 D;
3486 struct FloatVect3 temp;
3487 struct FloatVect3 temp2;
3488
3489 // Variables for the 3rd derivative components
3490 struct FloatVect3 t1, t2, t3, t4, t5, t6, t7;
3491
3492 FLOAT_VECT3_ZERO(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB);
3493 FLOAT_VECT3_ZERO(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d);
3494 FLOAT_VECT3_ZERO(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d);
3495 FLOAT_VECT3_ZERO(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d);
3496
3497 // xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
3498 pqr.x = LP.p.meas;
3499 pqr.y = LP.q.meas;
3500 pqr.z = LP.r.meas;
3501 pqr_dot.x = LP.p_dot.meas;
3502 pqr_dot.y = LP.q_dot.meas;
3503 pqr_dot.z = LP.r_dot.meas;
3504 pqr_ddot.x = LP.p_ddot.meas;
3505 pqr_ddot.y = LP.q_ddot.meas;
3506 pqr_ddot.z = LP.r_ddot.meas;
3507
3508 skew_symmetric(&Omega_B, &pqr);
3509 skew_symmetric(&Omega_B_dot, &pqr_dot);
3510 skew_symmetric(&Omega_B_ddot, &pqr_ddot);
3511 // xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
3512
3513 // nB = LBI * nI
3514 float_rmat_vmult(&oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB, LBI, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI);
3515
3516 // xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
3517 // nB_d= -Omega_B * nB + LBI * nI_dot
3518 float_rmat_vmult(&A, &Omega_B, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB);
3519 float_rmat_vmult(&B, LBI, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_d);
3520 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d, A);
3521 VECT3_ADD(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d, B);
3522
3523 // xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
3524 // nB_2d= -Omega_B_dot * nB - Omega_B * nB_dot - Omega_B * LBI * nI_dot + LBI * nI_2dot
3525#ifdef USE_ND_NB_2D
3526 static bool nB_2d_inited = false;
3527 static struct FloatVect3 nB_d_prev;
3528 if (!nB_2d_inited)
3529 {
3530 nB_d_prev.x = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.x;
3531 nB_d_prev.y = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.y;
3532 nB_d_prev.z = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.z;
3533 nB_2d_inited = true;
3534 }
3535 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.x = (oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.x - nB_d_prev.x) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
3536 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.y = (oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.y - nB_d_prev.y) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
3537 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.z = (oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.z - nB_d_prev.z) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
3538 nB_d_prev.x = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.x;
3539 nB_d_prev.y = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.y;
3540 nB_d_prev.z = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d.z;
3541#else
3542 float_rmat_vmult(&A, &Omega_B_dot, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB);
3543 float_rmat_vmult(&B, &Omega_B, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d);
3544 float_rmat_vmult(&temp, LBI, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_d);
3545 float_rmat_vmult(&C, &Omega_B, &temp);
3546 float_rmat_vmult(&D, LBI, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_2d);
3547 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d, A);
3548 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d, B);
3549 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d, C);
3550 VECT3_ADD(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d, D);
3551#endif
3552
3553 // xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
3554 // nB_3d = -Omega_B_ddot*nB - 2*Omega_B*Omega_B_dot*nB - Omega_B*Omega_B*Omega_B*nB
3555 // + LBI*nI_3d - 3*Omega_B*nB_2d - 3*Omega_B_dot*nB_d - 3*Omega_B*Omega_B*nB_d
3556#ifdef USE_ND_NB_3D
3557 static bool nB_3d_inited = false;
3558 static struct FloatVect3 nB_2d_prev;
3559 if (!nB_3d_inited)
3560 {
3561 nB_2d_prev.x = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.x;
3562 nB_2d_prev.y = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.y;
3563 nB_2d_prev.z = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.z;
3564 nB_3d_inited = true;
3565 }
3566 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.x = (oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.x - nB_2d_prev.x) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
3567 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.y = (oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.y - nB_2d_prev.y) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
3568 oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.z = (oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.z - nB_2d_prev.z) * PERIODIC_FREQUENCY;
3569 nB_2d_prev.x = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.x;
3570 nB_2d_prev.y = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.y;
3571 nB_2d_prev.z = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.z;
3572#else
3573 // t1 = Omega_B_ddot * nB
3574 float_rmat_vmult(&t1, &Omega_B_ddot, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB);
3575
3576 // t2 = 2 * Omega_B * Omega_B_dot * nB
3577 float_rmat_vmult(&temp, &Omega_B_dot, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB);
3578 float_rmat_vmult(&t2, &Omega_B, &temp);
3579 t2.x *= 2.0f;
3580 t2.y *= 2.0f;
3581 t2.z *= 2.0f;
3582
3583 // t3 = Omega_B * Omega_B * Omega_B * nB
3584 float_rmat_vmult(&temp, &Omega_B, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB);
3585 float_rmat_vmult(&temp2, &Omega_B, &temp);
3586 float_rmat_vmult(&t3, &Omega_B, &temp2);
3587
3588 // t4 = LBI * nI_3d
3589 float_rmat_vmult(&t4, LBI, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nI_3d);
3590
3591 // t5 = 3 * Omega_B * nB_2d
3592 float_rmat_vmult(&t5, &Omega_B, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d);
3593 t5.x *= 3.0f;
3594 t5.y *= 3.0f;
3595 t5.z *= 3.0f;
3596
3597 // t6 = 3 * Omega_B_dot * nB_d
3598 float_rmat_vmult(&t6, &Omega_B_dot, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d);
3599 t6.x *= 3.0f;
3600 t6.y *= 3.0f;
3601 t6.z *= 3.0f;
3602
3603 // t7 = 3 * Omega_B * Omega_B * nB_d
3604 float_rmat_vmult(&temp, &Omega_B, &oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_d);
3605 float_rmat_vmult(&t7, &Omega_B, &temp);
3606 t7.x *= 3.0f;
3607 t7.y *= 3.0f;
3608 t7.z *= 3.0f;
3609
3610 // Combine components into nB_3d state
3611
3612 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d, t2);
3613 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d, t3);
3614 VECT3_ADD(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d, t4);
3615 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d, t5);
3616 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d, t6);
3617 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d, t7);
3618 debug_state[0] = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.x;
3619 debug_state[1] = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.y;
3620 debug_state[2] = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.z;
3621 state_term[0] = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.x;
3622 state_term[1] = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.y;
3623 state_term[2] = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d.z;
3624 VECT3_SUB(oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_3d, t1);
3625
3626 float sigma_1 = RW.I.yy * (pqr.y * pqr_dot.z + pqr_dot.y * pqr.z) - RW.I.zz * (pqr.y * pqr_dot.z + pqr_dot.y * pqr.z);
3627 float sigma_2 = RW.I.xx * (pqr.x * pqr_dot.z + pqr_dot.x * pqr.z) - RW.I.zz * (pqr.x * pqr_dot.z + pqr_dot.x * pqr.z);
3628 float sigma_3 = RW.I.xx * (pqr.x * pqr_dot.y + pqr_dot.x * pqr.y) - RW.I.yy * (pqr.x * pqr_dot.y + pqr_dot.x * pqr.y);
3629 float upsilon_1 = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.y * sigma_3 / RW.I.zz + oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.z * sigma_2 / RW.I.yy;
3630 float upsilon_2 = oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.z * sigma_1 / RW.I.xx - oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.x * sigma_3 / RW.I.zz;
3631 float upsilon_3 = -oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.x * sigma_2 / RW.I.yy - oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.y * sigma_1 / RW.I.xx;
3632 state_term[0] += upsilon_1;
3633 state_term[1] += upsilon_2;
3634 state_term[2] += upsilon_3;
3635
3636 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_filt[0], oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.x);
3637 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_filt[1], oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.y);
3638 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_filt[2], oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB.z);
3639 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_2d_filt[0], oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.x);
3640 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_2d_filt[1], oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.y);
3641 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_2d_filt[2], oneloop_nB.sta_nB_state.nB_2d.z);
3642 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_3d_state_filt[0], state_term[0]);
3643 update_butterworth_2_low_pass(&nB_3d_state_filt[1], state_term[1]);
3644
3645#endif
3646}

3648void nB_EC(struct FloatVect3 nB, struct FloatVect3 nB_d, struct FloatVect3 nB_2d, struct FloatVect3 mu_B, float k1_e[3], float k2_e[3], float k3_e[3], float dist[3], float nB_nu[3])
3649{
3650 float nB_d_des[3];
3651 nB_d_des[0] = k1_e[0] * (mu_B.x - nB.x);
3652 nB_d_des[1] = k1_e[1] * (mu_B.y - nB.y);
3653 nB_d_des[2] = k1_e[2] * (mu_B.z - nB.z);
3654 float nB_2d_des[3];
3655 nB_2d_des[0] = k2_e[0] * (nB_d_des[0] - nB_d.x);
3656 nB_2d_des[1] = k2_e[1] * (nB_d_des[1] - nB_d.y);
3657 nB_2d_des[2] = k2_e[2] * (nB_d_des[2] - nB_d.z);
3658
3659 nB_nu[0] = k3_e[0] * (nB_2d_des[0] - nB_2d.x) + dist[0];
3660 nB_nu[1] = k3_e[1] * (nB_2d_des[1] - nB_2d.y) + dist[1];
3661 nB_nu[2] = 0.0; // k3_e[2]*(nB_2d_des[2]-nB_2d.z) + dist[2];
3662 // printf("nB_nu function: %f, %f, %f\n", nB_nu[0], nB_nu[1], nB_nu[2]);
3663}

3665void skew_symmetric(struct FloatRMat *out, const struct FloatVect3 *in)
3666{
3667 // Row 0
3668 out->m[0] = 0.0f; // (0,0)
3669 out->m[1] = -in->z; // (0,1)
3670 out->m[2] = in->y; // (0,2)
3671 // Row 1
3672 out->m[3] = in->z; // (1,0)
3673 out->m[4] = 0.0f; // (1,1)
3674 out->m[5] = -in->x; // (1,2)
3675 // Row 2
3676 out->m[6] = -in->y; // (2,0)
3677 out->m[7] = in->x; // (2,1)
3678 out->m[8] = 0.0f; // (2,2)
3679}

3681void rm_3rd_nI(float dt, struct FloatVect3 *x_ref, struct FloatVect3 *x_d_ref, struct FloatVect3 *x_2d_ref, struct FloatVect3 *x_3d_ref, const struct FloatVect3 *x_des, const float k1_rm[3], const float k2_rm[3], const float k3_rm[3])
3682{
3683 // printf("RM 3rd nI\n");
3684 // printf("x_ref: %f, %f, %f\n", x_ref->x, x_ref->y, x_ref->z);
3685 // printf("x_d_ref: %f, %f, %f\n", x_d_ref->x, x_d_ref->y, x_d_ref->z);
3686 // printf("x_2d_ref: %f, %f, %f\n", x_2d_ref->x, x_2d_ref->y, x_2d_ref->z);
3687 // printf("x_3d_ref: %f, %f, %f\n", x_3d_ref->x, x_3d_ref->y, x_3d_ref->z);
3688 // printf("x_des: %f, %f, %f\n", x_des->x, x_des->y, x_des->z);
3689
3690 float e_x[3];
3691 float e_x_d[3];
3692 float e_x_2d[3];
3693
3694 e_x[0] = k1_rm[0] * (x_des->x - x_ref->x);
3695 e_x[1] = k1_rm[1] * (x_des->y - x_ref->y);
3696 e_x[2] = k1_rm[2] * (x_des->z - x_ref->z);
3697
3698 e_x_d[0] = k2_rm[0] * (e_x[0] - x_d_ref->x);
3699 e_x_d[1] = k2_rm[1] * (e_x[1] - x_d_ref->y);
3700 e_x_d[2] = k2_rm[2] * (e_x[2] - x_d_ref->z);
3701
3702 e_x_2d[0] = k3_rm[0] * (e_x_d[0] - x_2d_ref->x);
3703 e_x_2d[1] = k3_rm[1] * (e_x_d[1] - x_2d_ref->y);
3704 e_x_2d[2] = k3_rm[2] * (e_x_d[2] - x_2d_ref->z);
3705
3706 // printf("e_x : %f, %f, %f\n", e_x[0], e_x[1], e_x[2]);
3707 // printf("e_x_d : %f, %f, %f\n", e_x_d[0], e_x_d[1], e_x_d[2]);
3708 // printf("e_x_2d: %f, %f, %f\n", e_x_2d[0], e_x_2d[1], e_x_2d[2]);
3709
3710 // 3rd derivative
3711 x_3d_ref->x = e_x_2d[0];
3712 x_3d_ref->y = e_x_2d[1];
3713 x_3d_ref->z = e_x_2d[2];
3714
3715 // integrate jerk -> acceleration
3716 x_2d_ref->x += dt * x_3d_ref->x;
3717 x_2d_ref->y += dt * x_3d_ref->y;
3718 x_2d_ref->z += dt * x_3d_ref->z;
3719
3720 // integrate acceleration -> velocity
3721 x_d_ref->x += dt * x_2d_ref->x;
3722 x_d_ref->y += dt * x_2d_ref->y;
3723 x_d_ref->z += dt * x_2d_ref->z;
3724
3725 // integrate velocity -> position
3726 x_ref->x += dt * x_d_ref->x;
3727 x_ref->y += dt * x_d_ref->y;
3728 x_ref->z += dt * x_d_ref->z;
3729
3730 // printf("Updated x_ref : %f, %f, %f\n", x_ref->x, x_ref->y, x_ref->z);
3731 // printf("Updated x_d_ref : %f, %f, %f\n", x_d_ref->x, x_d_ref->y, x_d_ref->z);
3732 // printf("Updated x_2d_ref: %f, %f, %f\n", x_2d_ref->x, x_2d_ref->y, x_2d_ref->z);
3733 // printf("Updated x_3d_ref: %f, %f, %f\n", x_3d_ref->x, x_3d_ref->y, x_3d_ref->z);
3734}

3749void SpinQuad_overwrite(float gain, float ce_model, float *nu_stab_2)
3750{
3751 SQ_r = 0.0;
3752
3753 if (SpinQuad || spin_man_rate_ctrl())
3754 {
3755 if (spin_man_rate_ctrl())
3756 {
3757 SQ_r = spin_man_r_ref; // signed yaw rate reference of the spin manoeuvre
3758 BoundAbs(SQ_r, 40.0);
3759 }
3760 else
3761 {
3762 SQ_r = (float)radio_control.values[RADIO_AUX4] / MAX_PPRZ * 40.0;
3763 Bound(SQ_r, 0.0, 40.0);
3764 }
3765
3766 *nu_stab_2 = (SQ_r - oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_d[2]) * k_att_e.k2[2];
3767 BoundAbs(*nu_stab_2, sta_bounds.att_2d[2]);
3768
3769 *nu_stab_2 = (*nu_stab_2 - oneloop_nB.sta_state.att_2d[2]) * gain;
3770 *nu_stab_2 += ce_model;
3771 }
3772}

3794// Calculate cos^{2n}((psi-xi)/2)
3795float cos_2n(float psi, float xi, int n)
3796{
3797 float c = cosf((psi - xi) / 2.0f); // cos((psi-xi)/2)
3798 float c2 = c * c; // cos^2((psi-xi)/2)
3799 float y = 1.0f;
3800 for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
3801 {
3802 y *= c2; // y = (cos^2(x))^n
3803 }
3804
3805 return y;
3806}

3823float pusher_cmd_fun(float aN_des, float aE_des, float r, float psi, float w, int n)
3824{
3825 float a_des_norm = sqrtf(aN_des * aN_des + aE_des * aE_des);
3826 float xi;
3827 if (a_des_norm > 0.1)
3828 {
3829 xi = xi_fun(r, w, aN_des, aE_des);
3830 }
3831 else
3832 {
3833 xi = psi + M_PI;
3834 NormRadAngle(xi);
3835 }
3836 // float pusher_cmd = a_des_norm * cos_2n(psi, xi, n);
3837 float pusher_cmd = cos_2n(psi, xi, n);
3838 Bound(pusher_cmd, 0.0f, 1.0f);
3839 return pusher_cmd;
3840}
